In a rap industry teeming with talent, few artists possess the raw energy and lyrical prowess of Fozter. Hailing from Imo State, Nigeria, Fozter has steadily carved his place in the scene, rising through the ranks with relentless determination.



Fozter 



 From viral freestyle challenges to securing co-signs from global rap icons like Tech N9ne and MI Abaga, his journey has been nothing short of extraordinary. Now, with the release of his latest project, FACADE, Fozter enters a new chapter—one shaped by personal betrayal, self-discovery, and unfiltered expression.



Truth In Every Bar



The project’s sonic landscape is sculpted by top-tier production, featuring the gripping instrumentals of KOE and the expert touch of Mixtrosity in the studio. The beats range from eerie and atmospheric to hard-hitting and aggressive, mirroring the turbulence of Fozter’s emotions.









Cultural & Industry Impact: A New Voice in the Rap Game



FACADE solidifies Fozter’s standing as a force to be reckoned with in Nigerian hip-hop. His ability to channel real-life experiences into gripping narratives sets him apart from his peers. This project not only highlights his evolution as a storyteller but also aligns him with a growing wave of African rap pioneers pushing the genre forward.Comparisons can be drawn to artists like Ladipoe, Blaqbonez, and Vector—rappers who have successfully merged technical skill with commercial appeal. However, Fozter’s relentless energy and battle-tested resilience give him a unique edge. His ability to thrive in competitive spaces, from the Hennessy VS Class to Boomplay’s Pass The Mic, has refined his artistry into something truly special.



Audience & Reception: Fans and Critics Take Notice



Since its release, FACADE has been met with an outpouring of support from fans and critics alike. Early reactions highlight the project’s lyrical depth, engaging storytelling, and top-tier production. Social media is ablaze with discussions on standout bars and the project’s emotionally charged themes.



 A Must-Listen for Hip-Hop Enthusiasts



FACADE is more than just an album—it’s a statement. A declaration of resilience, authenticity, and lyrical excellence. For those who appreciate rap in its purest form—sharp wordplay, compelling narratives, and beats that hit deep—this project is an essential listen.Whether you’re a long-time supporter or a new listener, now is the time to tune in, stream FACADE, and witness the rise of Fozter. Follow his journey, share the music, and be part of the movement. Because one thing is certain—this little rapper with big dreams is destined to take the world by storm. 🗽

Rising Afrobeats sensation Mosa Temple is back with an electrifying new body of work titled ‘Gbedu’, a project that cements his status as one of the most promising voices in the Nigerian music scene. Known for his ability to seamlessly fuse traditional Afrobeats elements with contemporary sounds, Mosa Temple delivers a record that is both infectious and sonically rich.







A Celebration of Rhythm and Culture



With ‘Gbedu,’ Mosa Temple takes listeners on a thrilling journey through pulsating beats, vibrant melodies, and captivating storytelling. Staying true to his signature style, Mosa Temple masterfully blends high-energy instrumentation with his effortlessly smooth vocal delivery, crafting a sonic experience that is both electrifying and soul-stirring. His ability to weave infectious melodies with rich, rhythmic production sets him apart, creating a soundscape that is as captivating as it is dance-inducing. 









With an innate talent for fusing Afrobeat, contemporary pop, and indigenous influences, Mosa Temple consistently delivers tracks that ignite the dance floor while maintaining an emotional depth that resonates with listeners on a deeper level.



The title itself, ‘Gbedu’—a popular Nigerian slang for “big tune” or “a song that commands attention”—perfectly captures the essence of this release. Mosa Temple ensures that the song lives up to its name by delivering an anthem that embodies the spirit of celebration, groove, and cultural pride.



A New Chapter in Mosa Temple’s Journey



Following the success of his debut project ‘Second Chance’, a two-track masterpiece that introduced his artistry to the world, Mosa Temple continues to evolve, refining his sound and expanding his musical reach. ‘Gbedu’ is a testament to his growth, creativity, and commitment to pushing the boundaries of Afrobeats.




        View this post on Instagram            A post shared by Enetule Mosa (@nonelikemosatemple)




Poised for a Breakthrough



With its pulsating production, engaging lyrics, and undeniable groove, ‘Gbedu’ has all the elements of a chart-topping hit. As Mosa Temple continues to gain traction in the Afrobeats industry, this release further solidifies his reputation as an artist to watch.







Fans can now stream ‘Gbedu’ on all major digital platforms and experience the infectious energy of Mosa Temple’s latest masterpiece. Whether you’re at a party, in the car, or vibing at home, one thing is certain—this is a Gbedu you don’t want to miss!



Stay connected with Mosa Temple on social media for more updates on his musical journey and upcoming projects.

In the ever-evolving Nigerian music scene, a new wave of talent is emerging, and one name that stands out is Mosa Temple. Officially known as Temple Enetule, this dynamic artist is carving a niche for himself with his versatile Afrobeats sound and undeniable talent. Born and raised in Lagos, Nigeria, but originally from Kogi State, Mosa Temple blends rich cultural influences with contemporary rhythms, setting him apart as a unique force in the industry.







A Name Rooted in Legacy



The name Mosa Temple holds deep significance. Derived from his late mother’s name, Mosadoluwa, it serves as a tribute to her memory and a source of inspiration in his musical journey. His artistry is not just about making music—it is a personal expression of his experiences, emotions, and cultural heritage.



A Natural-Born Afrobeats Maestro



Music has always been second nature to Mosa Temple. His versatility allows him to explore different sub-genres within Afrobeats, infusing his music with elements of highlife, afro-fusion, and contemporary pop. With smooth vocal delivery, rhythmic precision, and compelling storytelling, he creates songs that resonate deeply with his listeners.









Breaking into the Industry



On July 8, 2024, Mosa Temple made his official mark in the industry with the release of his debut project, ‘Second Chance’, a two-track project that showcased his artistic depth and potential. This milestone drew attention from both fans and industry insiders, cementing his presence in the Afrobeats scene.









Latest Release: ‘Gbedu’



Mosa Temple continues to elevate his craft with the release of his latest body of work, ‘Gbedu’. This project further highlights his ability to blend infectious rhythms with rich storytelling, solidifying his reputation as one of Afrobeats’ most promising rising stars.








Stream Gbedu




A Promising Future in Afrobeats



With his distinct sound and an unwavering passion for music, Mosa Temple is undoubtedly on the path to greatness. His ability to connect with his audience through rich melodies and heartfelt lyrics makes him a standout act in the Nigerian music landscape. As he continues to push creative boundaries, Mosa Temple is set to make a lasting impact not only in Nigeria but on the global Afrobeats scene.







Stay tuned for more from this rising star as he continues his musical journey, redefining Afrobeats with innovation and authenticity.

Rising Afro-Fusion artist Phlexzywest continues to captivate audiences with his latest release, “Vanilla.” This fresh offering blends Afrobeat, Dancehall, and R&B to create a smooth, infectious track that speaks of love and assurance.







A Sound that Stands Out



Produced by Noveece & Aymix Beats, “Vanilla” delivers a compelling rhythm and soulful melodies, making it a must-have for any playlist. Phlexzywest’s seamless fusion of Afro sounds with contemporary influences ensures that his music remains both refreshing and deeply resonate an intimate listening experience, making it a must-have on any playlist. The single reaffirms his ability to craft emotionally resonant music while keeping the energy high with his signature Afro-Fusion sound.









A Journey Rooted in Passion



Born Felix Owonifunja in Ekiti State, Nigeria, Phlexzywest’s musical journey began at the age of 15 when he discovered his talent in his church’s children’s choir. His official music career took flight in 2017 with the release of his breakout single, “Baby Wait.”







Since then, he has built an impressive catalog, including projects like Twilight EP and Distraction EP, solidifying his place as one of Abuja’s most promising artists. Drawing inspiration from legends such as Bob Marley, Fela Kuti, Lucky Dube, Michael Jackson, Wyclef Jean, and Labrinth, Phlexzywest continues to shape his unique Afro-Fusion sound.



A Vision for Global Impact



More than just an artist, Phlexzywest is committed to expanding the reach of Nigerian music worldwide. As the founder of Global Music, a media house dedicated to nurturing emerging talent, he is actively shaping the future of the industry. His sound represents a balance of deep cultural roots and modern innovation, making him a force to be reckoned with.



Stream “Vanilla”



Now Phlexzywest proves with each release that he is an artist on the rise. “Vanilla” is now available on Spotify, Apple Music, Audiomack, and all major streaming platforms.




Stream Vanilla

Emeke’s latest single, Ready or Not, bursts onto the music scene today, delivering an electrifying fusion of Afrobeats and Amapiano that’s set to captivate listeners worldwide. This track not only showcases Emeke’s dynamic artistry but also marks a significant milestone in his evolving musical journey.







The Artist Behind the Music



Hailing from Delta State, Nigeria, Emeke’s artistic journey is as diverse as his talents. A graduate of the University of Calabar, he seamlessly blends his passions for music, dance, and fashion, captivating audiences with his energetic performances. Beyond the stage, Emeke’s athleticism shines through his involvement in basketball, football, skateboarding, and martial arts. His creativity extends into hairstyling, where he crafts unique looks as a skilled barber. This multifaceted dedication underscores Emeke’s dynamic presence in the music industry.



Crafting “Ready or Not”



In Emeke’s own words, the creation of Ready or Not was a fiery collaboration: “I wrote the song and took it to the producer, and the heat was on.” This synergy is palpable in the track’s vibrant production, which melds rhythmic Afrobeats with the pulsating grooves of Amapiano. The result is an infectious soundscape that invites listeners to the dance floor, highlighting Emeke’s innovative approach to genre fusion.









Lyrical Depth and Themes



Ready or Not delves into themes of preparedness and seizing the moment, resonating with anyone poised on the brink of a new endeavor. Emeke’s lyrics serve as both a personal manifesto and a universal call to action, encouraging listeners to embrace opportunities head-on. The track’s compelling narrative is further enriched by collaborations with notable producers and featured artists, whose contributions add depth and texture to the overall composition.




        View this post on Instagram            A post shared by Emeke (@emekeglobal)




A New Chapter in Emeke’s Evolution



This release signifies a pivotal point in Emeke’s career, reflecting his growth and adaptability as an artist. Ready or Not not only aligns with current musical trends but also sets the stage for his upcoming projects, hinting at a future filled with bold explorations and boundary-pushing sounds. Early reactions from fans and industry insiders have been overwhelmingly positive, with many praising the track’s innovative blend of genres and its dance-inducing energy.







Join the Movement



Experience the vibrancy of Ready or Not by streaming it on your preferred platform today. Share your thoughts, join the conversation, and support Emeke as he continues to redefine the musical landscape. Your engagement not only fuels his artistic journey but also contributes to the rich tapestry of contemporary music.




Stream Now

IntroductionBritish-Nigerian rapper AnaYor is redefining hip-hop with his unique fusion of British rap and Nigerian vibrancy. Known for his introspective storytelling and genre-blending approach, AnaYor has been steadily carving out a niche in the music industry. 







His latest project, Broken Smile EP, released on March 7, is a testament to his artistic evolution, offering an emotionally charged and sonically diverse listening experience. Featuring collaborations with Ize and Robert Gillies, this EP delves into themes of mental health, resilience, and self-discovery, solidifying AnaYor’s place as a powerful voice in contemporary rap.



Project OverviewEach track on Broken Smile presents a distinct narrative, woven together by AnaYor’s compelling lyricism and dynamic production.










“Good Better Best” (ft. Ize) opens the EP with an anthemic energy, reflecting on personal growth and ambition. The synergy between AnaYor and Ize is undeniable, with poignant lyrics that capture the hunger for greatness.



“Hallelujah” is a deep, meditative piece that explores themes of struggle and redemption. With a haunting instrumental and AnaYor’s raw delivery, this track resonates as a spiritual outcry for resilience.





        View this post on Instagram            A post shared by AnaYor (@anayormusic)





“Inside My Head” takes listeners on an introspective journey, unraveling battles with mental health. The stripped-back production allows AnaYor’s storytelling to shine, making it one of the EP’s most vulnerable moments.



“Feel Good” (ft. Robert Gillies) juxtaposes heavy themes with an uplifting, melodic groove. Robert Gillies’ contribution adds an emotional depth that complements AnaYor’s heartfelt bars, making it a standout on the project.



“Biographies” serves as a reflective closing track, summarizing AnaYor’s journey, struggles, and aspirations. It’s a fitting end to an EP that is as much about self-exploration as it is about musical innovation.








Cultural & Industry ImpactBroken Smile EP is more than just a collection of songs—it’s a statement. AnaYor seamlessly blends elements of UK rap, Afrobeats, and soul, setting himself apart from conventional hip-hop artists. His storytelling mirrors the honesty of artists like Dave and J. Cole while incorporating the rhythmic influences of Nigerian music.




        View this post on Instagram            A post shared by AnaYor (@anayormusic)




The inclusion of Robert Gillies, a songwriter with credits for Charlie Puth and Machine Gun Kelly, adds another layer of depth to the project. This collaboration bridges AnaYor’s British-Nigerian roots with global influences, positioning him as a boundary-pushing artist in the rap scene.



Audience & ReceptionEarly reactions to Broken Smile highlight its emotional resonance and lyrical depth. Fans and critics alike have praised AnaYor’s ability to navigate complex topics with authenticity. Social media discussions surrounding tracks like “Inside My Head” suggest a strong connection with listeners who relate to its themes of mental health and self-reflection.







With its diverse sound palette and heartfelt narratives, the EP has the potential to secure placements on top rap and Afrobeats playlists, further expanding AnaYor’s reach. His innovative promotional strategies, including intimate listening sessions and interactive social media storytelling, have amplified anticipation and engagement around the project.



ConclusionAnaYor’s Broken Smile EP is a masterful blend of introspection, cultural fusion, and sonic experimentation. Whether you’re looking for thought-provoking lyricism or immersive beats, this project delivers on all fronts. Perfect for late-night reflections or long drives, Broken Smile invites listeners into AnaYor’s world, encouraging them to confront their own journeys of growth and healing.




Stream Broken Smile

Brace yourselves! Afro-Drill pioneer EESKAY is making a thunderous return, and this time, he’s bringing rap powerhouse DanDizzy along for the ride. Their highly anticipated collaboration, “STATE OF EMERGENCY,” is set to drop on April 4, 2025, and all signs point to this being a game-changer.







If you thought EESKAY had already pushed Afro-Drill to its limits, think again. This upcoming single promises to be his hardest-hitting track yet—an unexpected sonic assault that no one saw coming. With DanDizzy’s razor-sharp lyricism meeting EESKAY’s signature fusion of drill and Afrocentric vibes, the result is bound to be explosive. Fans and industry insiders alike are buzzing with anticipation, and here’s why you can’t afford to miss this drop.



What to Expect from “STATE OF EMERGENCY”



If the title is any indication, this song isn’t just music—it’s a declaration. EESKAY has built a reputation as the leading voice of Afro-Drill, skillfully blending modern drill beats with indigenous Nigerian elements. Now, he’s taking things up a notch, pushing the boundaries of the genre like never before.




        View this post on Instagram            A post shared by EESKAY DEM (@disrespectthe_gram)




Teasers and cryptic social media posts suggest “STATE OF EMERGENCY” will be a high-energy, hard-hitting banger, packed with street wisdom, unfiltered confidence, and an undeniable beat that will get heads nodding worldwide. DanDizzy’s presence guarantees fire bars, intricate wordplay, and the effortless freestyle energy that has made him one of Nigeria’s most respected rappers.



This isn’t the first time these two artists have joined forces. DanDizzy’s electrifying delivery on EESKAY’s hit track “Bad Character (Remix)” elevated the song to new heights, proving the undeniable synergy between them. Their ability to complement each other’s style makes “STATE OF EMERGENCY” an even more exciting prospect.



The production? Expect gritty 808s, pulsating drum patterns, and an infectious bounce that bridges the streets of Lagos with the raw energy of UK drill. It’s the perfect storm—two of Nigeria’s most electrifying artists on a beat that’s sure to command attention.



The Streets Are Talking—Industry & Fan Reactions



The moment EESKAY and DanDizzy hinted at this collaboration, the internet went into a frenzy. Fans have been flooding social media with speculations, dissecting every snippet, and trying to piece together what’s coming. Hip-hop heads, Afrobeat lovers, and drill enthusiasts alike are all gearing up for impact.



EESKAY’s past hits like “The Matter” and “Don’t Touch My Shit” set the foundation for Afro-Drill’s rise, while DanDizzy’s legendary freestyles and tracks like “Who Goes Der!” have made him a force to be reckoned with. With both artists at the top of their game, expectations for “STATE OF EMERGENCY” are sky-high.




        View this post on Instagram            A post shared by EESKAY DEM (@disrespectthe_gram)




Even industry insiders are taking notice. Some are already predicting this track could be one of the most impactful Nigerian drill songs of the year. Could this be the song that finally takes Afro-Drill fully global?



Why “STATE OF EMERGENCY” Is More Than Just a Song



This isn’t just another single—this is a moment. Afro-Drill is gaining momentum, and with artists like EESKAY leading the charge, the genre is poised to make waves on a global scale. “STATE OF EMERGENCY” could be the track that cements Afro-Drill’s place in mainstream African music.



Beyond the music, the rollout for this single has been nothing short of strategic genius. From cryptic teasers to exclusive listening sessions, EESKAY and DanDizzy are making sure fans stay on their toes. And let’s not forget the social media challenges, behind-the-scenes content, and unexpected surprises they might have in store.



One thing is certain: April 4, 2025, is about to be a cultural reset.

The wait is over! Ghanaian hip-hop artists Amos K and Bravo ISR have officially released their highly anticipated single, DREAMCHASER, featuring the soulful vocals of Farid. Dropping today, March 27, 2025, under KS Amplify Network LTD (Amplify Ghana), this track is set to captivate audiences with its compelling sound and powerful message.







Amos K: The Rhythmic Trailblazer



Amos Kodwo, widely known as Amos K, is a talented Ghanaian artist and producer who has been making waves in the industry since he began recording professionally in 2018. His unique blend of English, Twi, and Pidgin, combined with an allegro rap style, sets him apart in the hip-hop scene. Drawing influence from Kwesi Arthur, EL, Sarkodie, and Central Cee, Amos K infuses elements of drill music into his work while maintaining a contemporary and dynamic approach. With hard-hitting lyrics and an undeniable drive, he continues to push the boundaries of his craft.







Bravo ISR: A Visionary in the Music Scene



Bravo ISR is a musical powerhouse known for his authentic and soulful approach to hip-hop. His ability to craft melodies that resonate with deep emotions makes him a standout talent in the industry. His recent comeback track, Sor Me Mu, featuring Farid, showcased his ability to blend drill rhythms with heartfelt themes, marking a triumphant return after a two-year hiatus. Now, with DREAMCHASER, Bravo ISR is taking his artistic journey to new heights.



Farid: The Soulful Collaborator



Farid, the featured artist on DREAMCHASER, brings a rich, emotive dimension to the track. Known for his seamless ability to complement various musical styles, his contribution elevates the song’s sonic depth and lyrical resonance.



DREAMCHASER: A Fusion of Talent and Vision




        View this post on Instagram            A post shared by HOOD STAR ⭐️💡 (@bravo.isr)




Produced by the renowned Selly Beats, DREAMCHASER is a masterpiece that merges introspective storytelling with vibrant beats. This track serves as a powerful anthem about ambition, perseverance, and the relentless pursuit of greatness—a message that resonates deeply with today’s generation of dreamers and go-getters.



A Milestone in Artistic Evolution



For Amos K, DREAMCHASER is another bold step in his evolving career, following his acclaimed EP ARCHIVES and standout singles like Overseas. Meanwhile, Bravo ISR continues to build on his momentum from Sor Me Mu, further cementing his place in the hip-hop landscape. Their collaboration, enriched by Farid’s soulful touch, is set to make a lasting impact on the industry.



Stream DREAMCHASER Now!



The moment has arrived! DREAMCHASER is now available on all major streaming platforms. Immerse yourself in this inspiring track and let the music fuel your ambitions.




Stream Now

Get ready, music lovers! FR3Q, the vibrant Nigerian artist renowned for his seamless fusion of Afrobeats, dancehall, pop, and R&B, is set to release his highly anticipated single, I’m on the Way, on April 3, 2025. If you’ve been following his journey, you already know this is a moment you don’t want to miss.







With an ever-expanding fanbase and an innate ability to craft irresistible melodies, FR3Q continues to establish himself as a powerhouse in the music industry. Now, with I’m on the Way, he’s gearing up to take his artistry to the next level.



What to Expect from I’m on the Way



Based on teasers and snippets making the rounds, I’m on the Way promises to be a sensational hit. FR3Q has a unique talent for blending passion with rhythm, and this track is expected to showcase his signature sultry, infectious sound in a way that will keep listeners hitting repeat.







While details on potential collaborations and production credits remain under wraps, one thing is certain—this song is set to be a vibe! Whether it’s an anthem for lovers, a reflection of ambition, or simply a feel-good groove, FR3Q has a knack for delivering music that resonates.



The Buzz is Real



Even before its official release, I’m on the Way has sparked a wave of excitement on social media. Fans are speculating about its meaning—could it be about success, love, or a deeper spiritual journey? Given FR3Q’s well-known fascination with the number 3 and its significance to his identity, some are wondering if this song ties into that theme.



Industry insiders are also paying close attention, with murmurs that this could be one of his most defining releases yet. Coming off a string of past successes, FR3Q isn’t just making music—he’s creating a movement.



Why This Release Matters



FR3Q’s journey from Port Harcourt to the global stage has been nothing short of inspiring. I’m on the Way isn’t just another track—it’s a statement. As the Afrobeats wave continues to captivate global audiences, FR3Q is positioning himself as a key figure pushing the genre forward with his distinctive Afrobbean touch.



From his innovative sound to his deep cultural and spiritual influences, FR3Q is shaping more than just music—he’s crafting an identity that resonates deeply with fans worldwide.



With a strategic promotional campaign, exclusive pre-save links, and what promises to be an unforgettable rollout, this track could be the next big hit to dominate playlists everywhere.



Mark Your Calendars & Pre-Save Now!



The countdown is on! Don’t miss out—I’m on the Way drops April 3, 2025.

articles.body:
Afrobeat continues to evolve, and at the forefront of this movement is Mamuzo, a rising star who is redefining the genre with his infectious rhythms, smooth vocals, and innovative sound. With an unwavering commitment to creativity, Mamuzo blends traditional Afrobeat with contemporary influences, carving out a unique space in the global music scene.







A Sound Like No Other



Mamuzo’s music is an electrifying fusion of Afrobeat, contemporary pop, and rhythmic elements that make every track an anthem. His fearless approach to innovation allows him to push boundaries while staying true to the essence of Afrobeat. Whether delivering a high-energy club banger or a soulful, thought-provoking hit, Mamuzo consistently crafts music that resonates with audiences worldwide.









Setting Trends, Breaking Boundaries



More than just an artist, Mamuzo is a trendsetter. His music and artistic direction reflect his bold vision, influencing the next generation of Afrobeat musicians. With his genre-blending style, he introduces fresh sounds to the industry, proving that Afrobeat can be both deeply rooted and refreshingly experimental.









His recent release, “JAZZMAN,” featuring Tehn10, Soundboi Bme, and Davibegad djobidi, is a testament to his ability to innovate. Dropped on March 21, 2025, the track effortlessly merges Afrobeat with jazz elements, creating a sonic experience that is both groovy and sophisticated. This latest offering is proof that Mamuzo is not just following trends—he is setting them.



The Future is Mamuzo



With a rapidly growing fanbase and a catalog of hits making waves, Mamuzo is on the path to global recognition. His dedication to pushing the boundaries of Afrobeat ensures that his sound remains fresh, relevant, and impactful. As he continues to build momentum, one thing is certain—Mamuzo is a name the world will remember.




Visit Profile

articles.body:
Mamuzo is back with a fire-laced track that solidifies his presence in Nigeria’s vibrant music scene. His latest release, JAZZMAN, featuring Tehn10, SoundboiBME, and DJ Obidi, is more than just a song—it’s an anthem of perseverance, faith, and the hustle. Known for blending Afrobeat, highlife, and contemporary urban sounds, Mamuzo has consistently pushed boundaries, and JAZZMAN is no exception.







Song Overview



At its core, JAZZMAN is a motivational record laced with street wisdom. The recurring line, “Jazzman say make I leave am for God,” sets the tone, emphasizing patience and divine intervention in the face of adversity. The verses are packed with confidence and ambition, as Mamuzo and his collaborators trade lines about success, haters, and the importance of trusting the process.









Sonically, JAZZMAN fuses rhythmic percussion with rich basslines, creating a soundscape that’s both energetic and meditative. The chemistry between Mamuzo, Tehn10, and SoundboiBME is undeniable, each bringing their signature style to the track.



Cultural & Industry Impact



In an era where Afrobeat continues to dominate global charts, JAZZMAN stands as a testament to the genre’s storytelling power. The song draws comparisons to street anthems from artists like Olamide and Zlatan, but Mamuzo’s delivery adds a fresh dimension, blending introspection with bravado.









For Mamuzo, this track marks another high point in his career. Coming off the success of Rolling Dollar, JAZZMAN proves he’s here to stay, consistently crafting songs that resonate with both the streets and mainstream audiences.



Audience & Reception



Fans have quickly embraced JAZZMAN, with its catchy hook and relatable message sparking conversations on social media. Playlists across streaming platforms are already picking up the track, and with its high replay value, JAZZMAN has all the makings of a viral hit.







Conclusion



If you need a song that fuels your grind while reminding you to trust the process, JAZZMAN is a must-listen. Whether you’re in traffic, at a club, or reflecting on your journey, this track hits differently. Stream JAZZMAN now and let Mamuzo guide you through the hustle.




Stream JAZZMAN

The wait is over! Mamuzo has officially released his brand-new single, ‘JAZZMAN’, and it’s already making waves. Featuring an all-star lineup of Tehn10, SoundboiBME, and DJ Obidi, this track is set to dominate the airwaves and playlists starting today, March 21, 2025. If you’re a fan of infectious beats and innovative sounds, this is one release you don’t want to miss!







Mamuzo Sets the Stage for a Musical Takeover



Born Mamuzo Henry Diamond, the ‘Rolling Dollar’ hitmaker has proven time and time again why he’s one of the most promising artists from FCT Abuja. Hailing from Okpe, Delta, Mamuzo’s passion for music started at just six years old, and he has since crafted a sound that is both unique and captivating. With ‘JAZZMAN’, he continues his journey of pushing creative boundaries and solidifying his place in the industry.









What to Expect from ‘JAZZMAN’



So, what makes ‘JAZZMAN’ stand out? Beyond Mamuzo’s signature artistry, this track blends elements of Afrobeat, jazz influences, and high-energy production, making it a certified hit. With Tehn10’s lyrical finesse, SoundboiBME’s dynamic flow, and DJ Obidi’s expert touch, ‘JAZZMAN’ is a powerful collaboration that brings a fresh, genre-blurring vibe to the scene.




        View this post on Instagram            A post shared by Mamuzo Eni Diamond (@baddestmamuzo)




Lyrically and sonically, the song exudes confidence, rhythm, and an undeniable groove that listeners won’t be able to resist. Whether you’re a longtime fan or a new listener, this track is sure to get you moving.



A New Era for Mamuzo



The release of ‘JAZZMAN’ marks a significant milestone for Mamuzo, signaling a new chapter in his artistic evolution. With this drop, he’s proving that he’s not just here to participate—he’s here to lead. Could this be the beginning of a larger project? Only time will tell, but if ‘JAZZMAN’ is any indication, there’s a lot more in store from Mamuzo in the near future.







Stream ‘JAZZMAN’ Now!



The excitement is real, and the time is now! ‘JAZZMAN’ is officially out on all streaming platforms, ready to take over your playlists. Be among the first to experience the magic—stream it now, share it with your friends, and let the world know that Mamuzo has arrived in full force!



Follow Mamuzo on all social media platforms for exclusive content, behind-the-scenes footage, and upcoming project announcements.

The music industry is not for the faint of heart. It’s a space where talent alone isn’t enough—persistence, reinvention, and adaptability are just as crucial. Few artists embody these qualities as well as Vuga Kvngz. Born Chiedozie Eze Walter in Owerri, Imo State, Nigeria, Vuga has spent years navigating the highs and lows of the industry, carving out a space for himself through a unique fusion of Hip-Hop, Alternative, Afrobeats, and Reggae—a sound he calls “Vuga Vibes.”







From the bustling streets of Nigeria’s music scene to the unexpected avenues of Istanbul, Turkey, his journey has been defined by ambition, setbacks, and ultimately, triumph. His latest project, When Vuga Was Just Kvngz, released on March 14, 2025, stands as a powerful reflection of his artistic and personal evolution.



From Owerri to Istanbul: A Cross-Continental Music Journey



Vuga’s musical journey began at 19, after completing a Political Science degree. Like many young artists in Nigeria, he sought to break into the country’s highly competitive music industry. He spent years refining his sound, working in different capacities within the industry, and experimenting with various styles. However, the struggles of an independent artist in Nigeria, coupled with the challenges of sustaining a career in a saturated market, led him to seek new opportunities abroad.



Moving to Istanbul, Turkey, wasn’t just a change of location—it was a turning point. In Turkey, he found a fresh audience, a different creative landscape, and, most importantly, the space to reignite his passion for music. He began releasing music consistently, blending Nigerian influences with international sounds, and making a name for himself within Istanbul’s growing Afrobeats scene.



“When Vuga Was Just Kvngz” – A Testament to Growth



His latest project, When Vuga Was Just Kvngz, is more than just an EP—it’s a statement. A marker of his growth, resilience, and the defining moments that shaped him into the artist he is today. The project features five tracks:









With a guest feature from Jzty, the EP blends raw emotion with polished production, offering listeners a mix of introspection, energy, and infectious melodies.



Overcoming Setbacks to Create a Timeless Sound



The journey to completing When Vuga Was Just Kvngz wasn’t smooth. Early in the recording process, he faced a major setback—his original files were lost due to a producer’s mishap. Many artists would have seen this as a crushing blow, but for Vuga, it became a defining moment. Instead of dwelling on the loss, he used it as motivation to refine his sound and create something even better.







That’s when he linked up with Ceeceebeatz, a producer who became more than just a collaborator—he was a creative partner. Over an intensive two-week studio lockdown, they worked tirelessly, bouncing ideas off close friends, rewriting, refining, and pushing the limits of their creativity.



Some songs came together effortlessly, while others required hours of debate, revision, and trial runs. The result was a body of work that truly represents Vuga Kvngz—not just as an artist, but as a storyteller and visionary.



A Bright Future for Vuga Kvngz



With When Vuga Was Just Kvngz now out, the reception has been overwhelmingly positive. Fans have connected with the honesty in his storytelling, the seamless genre-blending, and the undeniable energy that defines the Vuga Vibes experience.









As he continues to build his career internationally, Vuga Kvngz proves that no matter where life takes you, true artistry will always find its way to the world. He’s not just making music—he’s crafting a legacy.



Stream When Vuga Was Just Kvngz now and witness the rise of a global star.



Listen Here

The countdown has begun! The electrifying Mamuzo is back with a fresh sonic masterpiece, and this time, he’s bringing the heat with his highly anticipated single, ‘JAZZMAN’—set to drop on March 21, 2025. Featuring an all-star lineup of Tehn10, SoundboiBME, and DJ Obidi, this track is already generating waves of excitement among fans and industry insiders alike. If you love infectious rhythms, bold artistry, and genre-blurring sounds, this is a release you won’t want to miss!







Meet Mamuzo: The Visionary Behind ‘JAZZMAN’



Born Mamuzo Henry Diamond, this rising star is no stranger to the music scene. Known for his breakout hit ‘Rolling Dollar’, Mamuzo has consistently proven himself as one of the most talented artists emerging from FCT Abuja. Hailing from Okpe, Delta, his musical journey began at just six years old, and he has since honed his craft, delivering hits that blend culture, storytelling, and an unmistakable groove. Now, with ‘JAZZMAN’, Mamuzo is ready to redefine his sound and set a new standard for his artistry.







Why ‘JAZZMAN’ is a Must-Listen



So, what makes ‘JAZZMAN’ so special? Beyond Mamuzo’s signature charisma and magnetic sound, this track celebrates rhythm and energy, infused with the talents of Tehn10, SoundboiBME, and DJ Obidi—each bringing their unique flavor to the mix. Expect a fusion of Afrobeat, jazz-inspired melodies, and hard-hitting production that promises to get listeners on their feet.



The song’s theme remains under wraps, but if Mamuzo’s past releases are anything to go by, we can expect a dynamic storytelling experience, pulsating beats, and an undeniable anthem in the making.



A Defining Moment for Mamuzo



With ‘JAZZMAN’, Mamuzo isn’t just dropping a song—he’s making a statement. This release marks a pivotal moment in his career, showcasing his growth as an artist and his commitment to pushing creative boundaries. For fans who have followed his journey, this single is an exciting preview of what’s to come. Could this be the beginning of a full-length project or an upcoming EP? Time will tell, but one thing is certain—Mamuzo is here to stay.

In the ever-expanding world of Afrobeats, fresh talents continue to emerge, bringing new energy and innovation to the genre. One such artist making waves is Eugene Dolph, a multi-talented singer, songwriter, and producer. With a unique blend of Afrobeats and Afro-fusion, Eugene is quickly carving out his space in Nigeria’s vibrant music industry.







Early Life and Musical Roots



Born Eugene Adholphus in Delta State, Nigeria, Eugene grew up surrounded by the rich musical heritage of his homeland. From an early age, he was captivated by traditional African rhythms, highlife music, and the growing influence of Nigerian pop icons. Inspired by industry legends such as Burna Boy, Wizkid, Davido, and Chief Stephen Osita Osadebe, he developed a deep passion for music, setting the stage for his career as an artist and producer.



Career Beginnings



Eugene Dolph officially stepped into the music scene in 2024, launching his career from Abuja, Nigeria. His entry into the industry was marked by a series of well-received singles that highlighted his versatility, from infectious dance anthems to introspective Afro-fusion tracks. Songs like Hot Body and One More Night showcased his ability to craft melodies that resonate with fans, blending rhythmic beats with soulful storytelling.









As a producer, Eugene quickly gained recognition for his ability to create fresh, dynamic soundscapes. His collaborative approach has allowed him to work with a diverse array of artists, fusing different regional styles into a distinct, universally appealing sound.



Breakthrough and Growing Recognition



In late 2024, Eugene Dolph took a significant step forward with the release of his highly anticipated collaborative album, featuring some of Nigeria’s most promising talents. This project not only solidified his presence in the industry but also demonstrated his ability to bridge genres and create music that appeals to a broad audience.









With an ever-growing fanbase, Eugene’s music continues to gain traction on streaming platforms, social media, and live performances. His artistic vision and dedication to the craft are rapidly positioning him as one of the new faces of Afrobeats.



Musical Style and Influences



Eugene’s sound is deeply rooted in Afrobeats, but he seamlessly incorporates elements of Afro-fusion, highlife, reggae, hip-hop, and pop music. His music reflects a balance between tradition and modernity, celebrating African heritage while embracing global influences.







His production style is marked by vibrant instrumentals, rhythmic percussion, and melodies that evoke deep emotions. Whether creating high-energy tracks for the dancefloor or crafting soulful ballads, Eugene consistently delivers music that connects with listeners on multiple levels.



Future Aspirations



Eugene Dolph’s journey is just beginning, but his ambitions extend far beyond personal success. He envisions using his platform to uplift emerging artists, mentor young producers, and contribute to the global recognition of African music.







“I want my music to be something that brings people together. Whether you’re in Lagos, London, or New York, I want to create a vibe that people can feel in their hearts.” — Eugene Dolph



With upcoming projects, international collaborations, and an unwavering dedication to his craft, Eugene is on a path to becoming a dominant force in the music industry. As he continues to evolve and push creative boundaries, his fans can expect even more groundbreaking releases in the years to come.



Stay Connected



Follow Eugene Dolph and stay updated on his latest releases and projects:




Instagram: @EugeneDolph



Spotify: Eugene Dolph on Spotify



Apple Music: Eugene Dolph on Apple Music



YouTube: Eugene Dolph’s Official YouTube Channel




With his undeniable talent and a growing catalog of music, Eugene Dolph is undoubtedly an artist to watch. Keep an eye on his journey as he continues to make his mark on the Afrobeats scene and beyond.

Lagos, Nigeria – March 8, 2025 – Nigerian singer, songwriter, and producer Joyce Olong is back with a soul-stirring new single, “Heartstrings,” a preview of her forthcoming project. Known for her emotive storytelling and genre-bending sound, Joyce delivers an intimate exploration of love, resilience, and the complexities of the human experience.







With a seamless fusion of Afrobeat, R&B, and soul, “Heartstrings” highlights Joyce’s signature style—balancing warm, melodic instrumentals with deeply personal lyricism. Her powerful vocals glide over the track’s lush production, drawing listeners into a world of vulnerability and strength.



“This song is incredibly personal to me,” Joyce shares. “It’s about embracing love in its purest form while finding the strength to move forward, even when the journey gets tough.”









Following her critically acclaimed releases, Joyce continues to carve out a unique space in the Nigerian and global music scenes. Her ability to weave rich sonic textures with introspective themes has earned her a dedicated fan base and recognition as a force in contemporary music.




        View this post on Instagram            A post shared by Joyce Olong (@joyceolong)




As she gears up for her next project, “Heartstrings” sets the stage for what promises to be an emotionally charged and sonically rich body of work.



Listen to “Heartstrings” here.

MBBszn, the rising Nigerian rapper and songwriter, has just dropped Ya Diba—a raw, unfiltered reflection of his turbulent journey through the music industry.




Known for his introspective storytelling and deep cultural ties, MBBszn once again delivers a track that resonates with authenticity.







A Story of Struggle and Resilience



Inspired by real-life events, Ya Diba is more than just a song—it’s an emotional outpouring of setbacks, lessons, and ultimately, perseverance. In December, MBBszn embarked on a trip to Lagos, hoping to take his career to the next level. However, instead of smooth success, he faced a string of challenges: an unreliable producer, a delayed distribution deal due to a dishonest intermediary, and even an unexpected arrest. Rather than letting these obstacles break him, MBBszn transformed his pain into music.



The Sound & Lyrics



From the opening lines—“Where do I begin?”—MBBszn takes us on a journey through his struggles. He vividly recounts the frustration of industry betrayal (“Ife men ne eme men na Industry a”) while maintaining an unshaken spirit (“But I’m not in my feelings so ya diba”)—a phrase that roughly translates to “let it be” or “move on.”









His verses paint a picture of Lagos’ unforgiving nature—one moment filled with promise, the next with chaos. “My producer go mental, my producer go craze… Industry make me mental, Lagos make me craze.” Yet, through the pain, he acknowledges the lessons learned: “No Pain, No Gain. Me I don dey pay my dues, e don tey.”









Sonically, Ya Diba blends rap with Afro-infused melodies, mirroring the emotional highs and lows of his experience. The chorus, hypnotic and repetitive, reinforces the mantra of resilience—pushing forward despite the madness.



A Testament to Growth



MBBszn’s Ya Diba is more than just another release—it’s a testament to his growth as an artist and as a person. His journey is a reflection of the struggles many young artists face in Nigeria’s competitive music scene. Yet, rather than let these setbacks define him, MBBszn is using them to fuel his fire.







With Ya Diba, MBBszn cements his place as a storyteller of his generation. As he continues to rise, one thing is clear—he’s not backing down anytime soon.



Stream Ya Diba now and experience the journey firsthand.

As the second single from his highly anticipated fifth studio album, Mother Tongue, this track promises to be a fearless statement of artistic authenticity and creative evolution.







A Glimpse Into “NIGGAZ WITH ATTITUDE”



Http//:riri, born Richard Ayomide Olamijulo, is an independent Nigerian musician currently based in Lithuania. Known for seamlessly blending R&B, Afrobeats, hip-hop, rap, and trap with a unique international flair, he has steadily built a dedicated fan base through self-produced albums and high-energy music videos. With thousands of streams to his name, NIGGAZ WITH ATTITUDE is another defining moment in his musical journey.



In his own words:




“Niggaz with Attitude is a bold, provocative ode to the legendary spirit of NWA and a candid reaction to the challenges and peer pressures in today’s music scene. As the second single from my upcoming 5th studio album, Mother Tongue, this track showcases my evolved sound and unwavering momentum. With hard-hitting lyrics that dismiss shallow attitudes and celebrate authenticity and relentless creativity, it’s a foreshadowing of the unstoppable energy and fresh stories I bring to every new song.”

In a world where struggles often overshadow the joys of everyday life, rising artist Star Sali delivers a refreshing reminder to embrace life’s “Happy Moments.” With this latest release, Star Sali crafts an uplifting anthem that encourages listeners to focus on the bright side, appreciating the small yet meaningful experiences that make life worthwhile.







The Inspiration Behind “Happy Moments”



According to the artist, Happy Moments was inspired by the reality that people often dwell on their struggles while overlooking the fleeting moments of joy. In Star Sali’s words:




“This song was composed and inspired based on the daily life situations where people tend to focus more on their struggles and forget about those little moments of happiness and joy. I intend to inspire every listener to try and dwell in their happy moments because life is too short, and we’ve got just once to live it.”








This heartfelt message is seamlessly woven into the fabric of the song, making it more than just music—it’s an experience that resonates with listeners on a personal level.



A Soundtrack for Positivity



Musically, Happy Moments blends smooth melodies, vibrant instrumentation, and Star Sali’s signature vocal warmth to create a song that is as soothing as it is motivational. The track’s uplifting rhythm and inspiring lyrics make it the perfect soundtrack for those looking to shift their mindset and celebrate the little joys in life.









Listen to “Happy Moments”



For those seeking a musical escape into positivity, Happy Moments is now available for streaming. Let Star Sali’s latest release be a reminder to embrace happiness in its simplest forms.



Listen now: Happy Moments

In the ever-evolving landscape of African music, fresh voices continuously emerge, captivating audiences with their unique sounds and compelling stories. One such artist making waves is Vherse, born Graham Nyincho, from the North West region of Cameroon. Since stepping into the music scene in 2022, he has garnered attention with his powerful melodies and heartfelt lyrics, establishing himself as an artist to watch.







The Journey to Fame



Vherse’s rise to prominence began on social media, where his viral cover songs and freestyles quickly amassed a dedicated fanbase. His talent and growing influence did not go unnoticed, catching the attention of ATM Entertainment—one of Cameroon’s most prominent record labels. This pivotal moment marked the beginning of an exciting musical career, opening doors to professional recordings and wider recognition.









The Breakthrough Single: “Aye”



In April 2023, Vherse released his debut single, Aye, a song inspired by real-life experiences. The track resonates with listeners, as it delivers a message of perseverance and determination in the face of adversity. Its infectious melody and deep lyrical content struck a chord with fans, prompting the release of an acoustic version due to popular demand. This stripped-down rendition showcases Vherse’s vocal prowess and ability to convey raw emotions through music.









A Fusion of African Sounds



Vherse’s sound is a seamless blend of Afrobeats, Makossa, and contemporary African rhythms, creating a distinctive musical identity. His follow-up single, Tell Me, further cements his artistry, demonstrating his versatility and ability to craft songs that appeal to a broad audience. Whether through energetic beats or soulful ballads, Vherse continues to push the boundaries of his craft.









What’s Next for Vherse?



With a rapidly growing discography and a dedicated fanbase, Vherse is undoubtedly on the path to greater heights. His presence on streaming platforms such as Spotify and Apple Music ensures that his music reaches a global audience, while his YouTube channel provides fans with engaging visuals and performances.







As Vherse continues to evolve and refine his artistry, his journey serves as an inspiration to aspiring musicians across Africa. His story is a testament to the power of talent, persistence, and the impact of connecting with fans on a personal level.



Stay Connected



To keep up with Vherse’s latest releases and updates, follow him on streaming platforms and social media:




Spotify: Vherse on Spotify



Apple Music: Vherse on Apple Music



YouTube: Vherse’s Official YouTube Channel




With his undeniable talent and a growing catalog of music, Vherse is poised to leave a lasting mark on the African music scene. Watch this space, as his journey is only just beginning!

Blending the raw intensity of UK Drill with the infectious rhythms of Afrobeats and the classic grit of American Hip-Hop, Nigerian-American rapper Ya ROE is pushing the boundaries of genre with his latest EP, YAHOOCORE. More than just a collection of songs, this project is a bold statement—an artistic manifesto that bridges continents and musical styles.







A Global Sound, A Personal Journey



Raised between Nigeria and America, Ya ROE’s music reflects the duality of his experiences. From the energy of the streets to the vibrant pulse of Toronto, his sound is a melting pot of influences. Now based in Ontario, Canada, he seamlessly blends the hard-hitting beats of UK Drill, the soulful essence of Classic Hip-Hop, and the high-energy vibes of Trap music. What makes YAHOOCORE truly stand out, however, is his ability to weave Afrobeats into these Western styles, creating a fusion that is as authentic as it is groundbreaking.



What is YAHOOCORE?



At its core, YAHOOCORE is a fearless experiment in genre fusion. The title nods to a tech-savvy generation while paying homage to Ya ROE’s Nigerian heritage and the digital-age hustlers shaping the diaspora. This EP isn’t about playing by the rules—it’s about breaking them, redefining soundscapes, and pushing creative boundaries.









With hard-hitting drill beats, trap-driven flows, and rhythmic elements that could easily set a Lagos dance floor on fire, YAHOOCORE is a testament to Ya ROE’s ability to innovate. Each track tells a story—not just of ambition and hustle, but of identity, belonging, and the complexity of navigating multiple cultures.



Global Appeal, Local Roots



What sets Ya ROE apart is his ability to resonate with listeners across different backgrounds. His music is both personal and universal, a reflection of his journey as an immigrant and an artist who exists between two worlds. YAHOOCORE captures the tension of these influences while celebrating the beauty of cultural fusion.







A New Era of Hip-Hop



With YAHOOCORE, Ya ROE is not just making music—he’s reshaping the sound of modern hip-hop. His fearless approach places him at the forefront of the global music scene, proving that boundaries are meant to be crossed. Whether you’re drawn to the bass-heavy beats of drill or the pulsating energy of Afrobeats, YAHOOCORE offers something for every listener.



This is more than an EP—it’s a movement. And Ya ROE is leading the charge.

Emerging Afro-pop talent Lurd Yung Zee is back with a heartfelt new single, SIGNS, a song dedicated to both God and his ever-growing fanbase. With a sound that blends deep emotion, powerful lyricism, and an undeniable passion for music, the young artist delivers an appreciation anthem that speaks to the trials, triumphs, and unwavering support he has received throughout his journey.







Born Edwinyung Z. O., the 22-year-old artist proudly embraces his Nigerian and Jamaican roots. While his father hails from Benue State, Nigeria, and his mother from Jamaica, he humorously claims, “Well, I choose Jamaican lol.” His musical journey is one of persistence, passion, and evolution, having recorded his first song on December 13, 2012, at a time when he was willing to miss classes just to chase his dream.




“Music keeps me sane, so for my sanity, I always create new sound cause it helps ease my pain.” – Lurd Yung Zee










From Studio Rat to Rising Star



Lurd Yung Zee’s dedication to his craft is evident in his work ethic. Always present and prepared, he never arrives late to a studio session, and his producers never have to wait for him to be ready. He describes making music as “fun and exciting”, revealing that he often skipped classes just to bring his ideas to life. His hunger for growth has led him to continuously refine his skills, ensuring that every track he releases is both meaningful and mood-driven.




        View this post on Instagram            A post shared by 1LURD (@lurdyungzee1)




He likens his journey to the viral Davido on his knees meme, emphasizing that he is willing to try everything—even beg—to make things happen. This relentless drive has led him to create standout projects like his debut album, GOD OVER DAWGZ, which he considers his best work to date due to its depth and replay value. Other notable projects include FLEX and SIGNS, both of which reflect his intentional approach to life and his gratitude for every experience.



What’s Next for Lurd Yung Zee?



While SIGNS is the current anthem of appreciation, Lurd Yung Zee has no plans of slowing down. He has three projects ready for release, but he’s waiting on final clearances from featured artists. However, fans won’t have to wait too long—his upcoming EP, I, God & BANDOs, is set to drop soon, promising another exciting chapter in his musical evolution.




“No matter how tough the journey gets, getting to the top will always be my priority.” – Lurd Yung Zee








As he continues to carve his place in the industry, Lurd Yung Zee remains a testament to perseverance, passion, and purpose. With SIGNS setting the tone for what’s to come, his future in music looks brighter than ever.



Connect with Lurd Yung Zee




Instagram: @lurdyungzee1



Twitter/X: @lurdyungzee



Spotify & Apple Music: LURD YUNG ZEE




Stream SIGNS now and stay tuned for more music from this rising star!

“Hot Remix” by VJ Skinny is turning heads in the Afrodrill arena, blending hard-hitting drill beats with infectious Afro-inspired rhythms. The track is a sonic explosion that fuses the raw intensity of drill music with the vibrant, soulful pulse of African sounds—a combination that’s as innovative as it is electrifying.







A Dynamic Collaboration



This track features dynamic verses from Moefasa and Reeplay, each bringing their distinctive flair to the mix. Moefasa lays down gritty, powerful lines that perfectly complement the pounding beat, while Reeplay’s verse stands out as a testament to his rising influence in Nigeria’s contemporary hip-hop scene. Known as a key figure in the Anti World Gangsters collective, Reeplay has made waves with his versatility and unapologetic delivery. His recent EP, Charge It to the Game, showcased his ability to effortlessly switch between menacing rap flows and more melodic, pop-leaning cuts—a versatility that’s vividly on display in “Hot Remix.”









A Sonic Journey Through Afrodrill



VJ Skinny’s production on “Hot Remix” is both innovative and meticulously crafted. The track marries aggressive drill instrumentation with rich Afro rhythms, creating a soundscape that feels both futuristic and deeply rooted in African musical tradition. This synthesis of styles not only pays homage to the heritage of Afrobeat but also pushes the boundaries of modern drill music. The result is an anthem that’s not just heard, but felt—its beats resonating with energy and its lyrics echoing the pulse of urban street culture.



Why “Hot Remix” Stands Out




Energetic Production: VJ Skinny’s signature production style injects the track with a relentless energy that makes it a perfect fit for high-octane playlists. The intricate layering of drill beats and Afro rhythms creates an auditory experience that is as engaging as it is innovative.



Lyrical Finesse: With verses from both Moefasa and Reeplay, the track offers a rich tapestry of lyrical prowess. Reeplay’s contribution is particularly notable; his verse not only reinforces his status in Nigeria’s hip-hop scene but also enhances the track’s overall intensity and appeal.



Cultural Fusion: “Hot Remix” is a shining example of how contemporary African artists are redefining genres. By blending the stark, energetic elements of drill with the melodic and rhythmic nuances of Afro music, the track encapsulates a forward-thinking approach to sound that resonates with fans of both genres.




A Must-Listen Anthem



For enthusiasts of Afrodrill and modern African hip-hop, “Hot Remix” is an essential addition to any playlist. Its bold energy and innovative sound make it more than just a track—it’s a statement of artistic evolution in a genre that continues to push musical boundaries. Whether you’re a long-time aficionado or new to the scene, the track promises to deliver an unforgettable auditory journey.



As the Afrodrill movement gains momentum on the global stage, tracks like “Hot Remix” by VJ Skinny are at the forefront of this musical revolution. The collaboration between visionary producers and dynamic lyricists not only highlights the talent inherent in the genre but also sets the stage for even greater innovation in the years to come.



Dive into the world of “Hot Remix” and experience the cutting-edge fusion of sound that’s redefining modern African music.

A fresh and dynamic voice has emerged in the Afrobeats landscape—BLVCKBOYSGNS. Marking his official debut, he unveils his highly anticipated single, Nitori, a track set to make waves in the industry.



BLVCKBOYSGNS is an emerging Afrobeats artist with a deep passion for storytelling through music. His unique sound blends Afro-fusion, Amapiano, and Dancehall influences, creating a contemporary and refreshing musical experience.







Produced by the talented GFlame, Nitori showcases BLVCKBOYSGNS’ signature style—a seamless fusion of Afrobeats percussion with Afro-fusion elements. The song delivers an infectious mix of rhythmic beats, smooth melodies, and vibrant energy, making it an instant crowd-pleaser.



A feel-good anthem, Nitori celebrates love and the willingness to go the extra mile for one’s significant other. With catchy hooks and an alluring groove, the track is designed to resonate with audiences worldwide.




        View this post on Instagram            A post shared by BLVCKBOYSGNS🌪️ (@blvckboysgns)




Reflecting on his journey, BLVCKBOYSGNS shares, “I’m excited to share my sound with the world. They’re not ready for what’s about to hit them.” With Nitori, he signals his readiness to leave a lasting mark on the global Afrobeats scene.







The single is now available on all major streaming platforms, including Spotify, Apple Music, and Audiomack. Stay tuned as BLVCKBOYSGNS continues to rise and redefine the sound of contemporary Afrobeats.

Lucy Queen Eneh, popularly known as Lucy Q, is a trailblazing indigenous rapper redefining the Nigerian hip-hop scene with her fiery lyricism and unapologetic Igbo rap style. Hailing from Eziagu, Enugu State, Lucy Q has carved a unique space for herself in a genre dominated by male artists, proving that talent and perseverance know no boundaries.







With a career that gained momentum following her electrifying feature on iLLBliss’ 2017 viral hit “Chukwu Agozigo Gi (Remix)”, Lucy Q has continued to push the boundaries of indigenous rap. Her ability to blend traditional Igbo storytelling with contemporary hip-hop beats has earned her widespread recognition and a growing fanbase.



Early Life & Musical Journey



Lucy Q’s passion for music was evident from a young age. Growing up in Eziagu, Enugu State, she was deeply influenced by her cultural heritage and the rhythmic cadence of Igbo language, which later became a defining element of her sound.



She pursued her secondary education at Holy Rosary College, Uwani, Enugu, before advancing to the University of Nigeria, Nsukka (UNN), where she obtained a degree in International Relations. However, her love for music remained unwavering, and she fully embraced her artistic journey while still in school.



Her breakthrough moment came in 2015 when she delivered a standout performance at Star Trek Abuja, a platform that exposed her to a larger audience. This led to her being recognized by iLLBliss, one of Nigeria’s most respected rap moguls, who crowned her the Queen of Igbo Rap.



Musical Style & Influence



Lucy Q’s music is a bold fusion of hip-hop and indigenous Igbo storytelling. Her delivery is fierce, her lyrics thought-provoking, and her energy unmatched. She seamlessly blends the raw essence of street rap with cultural narratives, making her a voice for the new generation of African hip-hop artists.









Inspired by rap icons like iLLBliss, Phyno, and M.I Abaga, she has developed a unique sound that celebrates her Igbo roots while resonating with a global audience.



Discography & Notable Works



Lucy Q has remained consistent in her craft, dropping hits that showcase her lyrical dexterity and cultural pride. Some of her most notable works include:










Zelum (2016) – Her debut official single, marking her entry into the industry



ZoneOut Sessions – A freestyle performance that showcased her raw talent



Igbo – A tribute to her heritage and the strength of the Igbo people



Akwamozu – A hard-hitting rap anthem that displays her lyrical confidence



Ludak Black – A street-inspired banger



Pablo – A storytelling masterpiece



Big Baller – A high-energy hip-hop track



Networth – A testament to her growth and dominance in the rap industry




Her collaborations with industry heavyweights like iLLBliss, Terry Apala, Pepenazi, and Mz Kiss further solidify her position as one of Nigeria’s top female rappers.



Achievements & Industry Recognition




Crowned “Queen of Igbo Rap” by iLLBliss



Featured on iLLBliss’ “Chukwu Agozigo Gi (Remix)”, a track that went viral in 2017



Star Trek Abuja standout performance (2015), a defining moment in her career



Recognized as one of Nigeria’s top indigenous female rappers, inspiring a new wave of female hip-hop artists




Impact & Legacy



Lucy Q is more than just a rapper; she is a cultural icon in the making. By staying true to her roots and embracing indigenous rap, she is paving the way for more artists to celebrate their heritage through music.







Her ability to command attention with her flows, confidence, and storytelling has positioned her as a leader in the Nigerian rap scene. As she continues to evolve, Lucy Q remains committed to pushing the boundaries of indigenous hip-hop while inspiring the next generation of artists.

Her breakthrough moment came in 2015 when she delivered a standout performance at Star Trek Abuja, a platform that exposed her to a larger audience. This led to her being recognized by iLLBliss, one of Nigeria’s most respected rap moguls, who crowned her the Queen of Igbo Rap.

Musical Style & Influence

Lucy Q’s music is a bold fusion of hip-hop and indigenous Igbo storytelling. Her delivery is fierce, her lyrics thought-provoking, and her energy unmatched. She seamlessly blends the raw essence of street rap with cultural narratives, making her a voice for the new generation of African hip-hop artists.

Inspired by rap icons like iLLBliss, Phyno, and M.I Abaga, she has developed a unique sound that celebrates her Igbo roots while resonating with a global audience.

Discography & Notable Works

Lucy Q has remained consistent in her craft, dropping hits that showcase her lyrical dexterity and cultural pride. Some of her most notable works include:

  • Zelum (2016) – Her debut official single, marking her entry into the industry
  • ZoneOut Sessions – A freestyle performance that showcased her raw talent
  • Igbo – A tribute to her heritage and the strength of the Igbo people
  • Akwamozu – A hard-hitting rap anthem that displays her lyrical confidence
  • Ludak Black – A street-inspired banger
  • Pablo – A storytelling masterpiece
  • Big Baller – A high-energy hip-hop track
  • Networth – A testament to her growth and dominance in the rap industry

Her collaborations with industry heavyweights like iLLBliss, Terry Apala, Pepenazi, and Mz Kiss further solidify her position as one of Nigeria’s top female rappers.

Achievements & Industry Recognition

  • Crowned “Queen of Igbo Rap” by iLLBliss
  • Featured on iLLBliss’ “Chukwu Agozigo Gi (Remix)”, a track that went viral in 2017
  • Star Trek Abuja standout performance (2015), a defining moment in her career
  • Recognized as one of Nigeria’s top indigenous female rappers, inspiring a new wave of female hip-hop artists

Impact & Legacy

Lucy Q is more than just a rapper; she is a cultural icon in the making. By staying true to her roots and embracing indigenous rap, she is paving the way for more artists to celebrate their heritage through music.

Her ability to command attention with her flows, confidence, and storytelling has positioned her as a leader in the Nigerian rap scene. As she continues to evolve, Lucy Q remains committed to pushing the boundaries of indigenous hip-hop while inspiring the next generation of artists.

In a bold move that signals the dawn of a new era for Nigerian music, the Jos-based collective Northorious has officially released their highly anticipated debut project, NORTHORIOUS, on February 18, 2025. This landmark release is more than just an album—it is a statement, a revolution, and a cultural awakening for the northern music scene.







A Project Rooted in Vision and Unity



From the very first note, NORTHORIOUS exudes raw energy, innovation, and an unapologetic northern spirit. The project was spearheaded by Asound, the collective’s initiator, with Miles Ayo and Dexywane playing instrumental roles in shaping its direction. Their vision? To change the narrative of the music industry in Jos and prove that the next wave of global superstars can rise from northern Nigeria.









A Tracklist That Commands Attention



The 9-track project is a masterclass in versatility, featuring an all-star lineup of Northorious members:








Chillalo – YN Asahd, Xaint Jhaypee, Sazzy Sos, Timzy Mani, Danziko, Snowflexxy, Asound, Miles Ayo



Puta – Danziko, Xaint Jhaypee, Asound, YN Asahd, Sazzy Sos, Miles Ayo



Taste – Ammiee, Xaint Jhaypee, Dexywane, YN Asahd, Timzy Mani



Mariah – YN Asahd, Danziko, Asound, Xaint Jhaypee, Snowflexxy, Miles Ayo, Dexywane, Timzy Mani, Sazzy Sos



Love Wey Sweet – Xaint Jhaypee, Sazzy Sos, Danziko, YN Asahd, Ammiee, Miles Ayo, Timzy Mani



Aisha – Sazzy Sos, Timzy Mani, Snowflexxy, Danziko, Asound, Miles Ayo, YN Asahd



My Eyes See – Xaint Jhaypee, Miles Ayo, Snowflexxy, Asound, Dexywane, Sazzy Sos, Ammiee



Ekelebe – Snowflexxy, Miles Ayo, Sazzy Sos, Asound, Xaint Jhaypee, YN Asahd



Northorious – Asound, Snowflexxy, Miles Ayo, Danziko, Sazzy Sos




With contributions from some of Jos’ finest producers—Sica Tunes, Pvndv Madeit, and Peezythaproducer—the project delivers a sonically rich experience that blends Afrobeats, R&B, trap, and contemporary fusion into a seamless listening journey.



The Creative Process & The Message



According to Northorious, NORTHORIOUS is more than music—it’s a movement. The collective aims to challenge the industry’s status quo and showcase the unparalleled talent of Jos.



“For too long, the industry has overlooked the North. This project is our way of saying, ‘We are here, and we are ready to take over,’” says Asound.



Each track tells a unique story—of love, struggle, ambition, and the resilience of young creatives determined to carve their path in an industry often dictated by major cities like Lagos and Abuja.



What Makes NORTHORIOUS Stand Out?








Diverse Soundscapes – The album blends Afrobeat rhythms, soulful R&B melodies, and trap-infused beats.



Collaborative Excellence – With multiple artists on each track, the synergy between voices and styles is electric.



Authenticity & Purpose – Every song is deeply rooted in the realities of the artists, making it relatable and emotionally compelling.




Final Thoughts



With NORTHORIOUS, Northorious has not only put Jos on the map but has also redefined what it means to be an independent collective in Nigeria. This is just the beginning of their journey, and if this debut project is anything to go by, the future of music from the North is incredibly bright.



Stream NORTHORIOUS on all platforms now and witness the rise of a new era in Nigerian music.

articles.body:
For too long, the Nigerian music industry has been defined by a few major cities—Lagos, Abuja, and Port Harcourt—while other regions, bursting with talent, remain overlooked. But now, a bold collective from Jos is shaking things up. Their name? Northorious.







Northorious is not just another group of artists—it’s a revolution. Formed by Afro-fusion artist Asound, with early support from Miles Ayo and Dexywane, this collective embodies a fresh wave of northern talent determined to put Jos on the global music map.The lineup includes Asound, YN Asahd, Dexywane, Sazzy Sos, Snowflexxy, Xaint Jhaypee, Miles Ayo, Danziko, Timzy Mani, and Ammiee—all of whom bring their unique artistry to the table.



With the release of their debut project, NORTHORIOUS, the collective delivers a powerhouse of genre-blending sounds, raw emotions, and bold storytelling. The album, featuring dynamic tracks like Chillalo, Taste, and Northorious, showcases the versatility of its members, from the melodic rap of YN Asahd to the enchanting vocals of Ammiee and the high-energy delivery of Sazzy Sos.



AsoundDexywaneMiles AyoDanzikoSazzy sosSnowflexxyYN AsahdXaint JhaypeeAmmieeTimzy Mani



But beyond the music, Northorious stands for something greater—unity, culture, and a shift in perspective. Jos, a city known for producing legends like MI Abaga and Ice Prince, has long been a breeding ground for talent. Yet, many artists feel the pressure to relocate to Lagos or Abuja to “make it.” Northorious is here to challenge that notion.









The creative process behind NORTHORIOUS was driven by a shared vision: to highlight Jos as a music powerhouse. With production credits from Sica Tunes, Pvndv Madeit, and Peezythaproducer, the album is an authentic representation of the collective’s diverse influences, blending Afrobeat, R&B, and contemporary soundscapes.



“We want people to see the talent, the stories, and the soul of Jos in every note and lyric,” says Asound. “This is not just music; it’s history in the making.”



With a growing fan base and a clear vision, Northorious is proving that the sound of the next generation is coming from the North. And this is only the beginning.

In an industry brimming with talent, few artists shine as brightly as BlaqRose. Hailing from Makurdi, Benue State, and now thriving in Abuja, BlaqRose is redefining the Afrobeat and Afropop landscape with his infectious rhythms and compelling storytelling.







A Computer Science graduate from Veritas University, Abuja, BlaqRose is a testament to the fusion of intellect and artistry. His ability to translate emotions into music has earned him a dedicated fanbase and respect among industry peers. Whether it’s the introspective depth of “Temptation,” the raw energy of “Sapa Riddim,” or the electric vibes of “Baddermann – Remix,” BlaqRose delivers music that speaks to the soul.









Beyond his solo projects, he has collaborated with some of the finest talents in the Abuja music scene, including Zumzy Brown, Kinj K.A.D.E, Kishboy, Ghandi, AfroFaya, and Izzy Vibez. These collaborations have not only showcased his versatility but have also cemented his place as a key player in Nigeria’s evolving music industry.









BlaqRose is more than just an artist—he is a movement. His music transcends borders, weaving together tales of struggle, success, and self-discovery. With every beat, he invites listeners into his world, where dreams take flight and obstacles become mere stepping stones.







As he continues to rise, one thing is clear: the world hasn’t seen the best of BlaqRose yet. And when the time comes, his name will be etched among the greats of Afrobeat.

Mdundo, Africa’s top music platform, is doubling down on its support for Nigerian musicians, ensuring they earn fair rewards for their craft. With a booming user base of 38.7 million Monthly Active Users and strong partnerships with Nigerian telco giants like Glo and MTN, Mdundo is driving the “Naija to the World” movement, helping artists monetize their talent locally and globally.



The Mdundo 2024 royalty payout season is in full swing, with thousands of Nigerian artists—from rising Afrobeat stars to Hausa music legends—receiving their earnings. Since launching, over 200,000 African artists have earned via Mdundo, and Nigeria’s vibrant music scene continues to dominate the platform. This aligns with Mdundo’s vision to build a sustainable future for African creatives.



Martin Nielsen, Mdundo CEO, shared:“Our mission has always been to offer African artists a sustainable platform to thrive. By delivering consistent and substantial earnings, we are contributing to the growth of individual artists while supporting the long-term development of the African music industry as a whole..”



Mdundo’s catalog thrives through collaborations with global labels like Universal Music and homegrown powerhouses such as Mavin Records. The platform also prioritizes Naija-centric genres like Afrobeat, Fuji, and Hausa music, ensuring local sounds resonate globally.



Phiona Nafuna, Head of Licensing, added:“Mdundo remains focused on empowering African musicians by ensuring fair and timely compensation. This is central to our mission to support artists, enhance the structure of the music industry, and contribute to the growing legal and financial framework within the sector.”



By 2026, Mdundo aims to disburse $1.5–2 million in royalties, with Nigerian artists leading the charge. Through telco deals, hyperlocal promotions, and user-friendly tools, Mdundo remains the go-to platform for Naija artists to thrive.
