Nigerian-born singer, rapper, songwriter, and producer Bennixx, also known as Soundfyar, is back with a soul-stirring new single titled Cold. This track marks his first official release of the year. It serves as a preview of his highly anticipated SF2 EP, set to drop later this year.







A Rising Star with a Distinct Sound



Zenke Benjamin, professionally known as Bennixx, hails from Benue State. He spent his formative years in Ibadan. Later, he returned to further his education at BSU. Now based in Abuja, Bennixx has continued to refine his musical artistry. Music has been an integral part of his life since childhood, heavily influenced by his family’s passion for the art. Bennixx was actively involved in his school band. He began composing songs at the young age of 15. This experience has nurtured his craft into a unique fusion of sounds.







His previous works include Shan Pepe, BadBouy, Adura, and Bags on Bags featuring Maleeqsouls. These have earned him recognition in the industry. His debut project, Soundfyar EP, garnered thousands of streams across digital platforms. This solidified his place as a force to watch in the music scene.



The Creative Vision Behind ‘Cold’



According to Bennixx, Cold is a deeply introspective piece that explores the contrast between love and the realities of life. “When I was creating Cold, I wanted to bring together two worlds—love and the realness of life. The idea was to blend the warmth of love with moments of emotional distance. These moments show how relationships can sometimes make you feel slowed down. It feels almost frozen, in a good way,” he shares.









The track’s chorus encapsulates this sentiment. It expresses a love that is both intense and chilling. This paradox resonates deeply with listeners. Bennixx started the creative process with the melody, aiming for a sound that feels relaxed yet emotionally powerful. “I wanted the production to complement that. It should have layers of warmth and coolness. This applies both in the sound and the message,” he explains.



With its heartfelt lyrics and immersive production, Cold is designed to evoke a mix of emotions—love, nostalgia, and introspection. It’s a song that encourages listeners to slow down and think, all while getting lost in its mesmerizing rhythm.



Anticipating the SF2 EP



Bennixx is preparing for the release of his self-produced SF2 EP. Cold offers a glimpse into the sonic direction. It also reveals the emotional depth that fans can expect. His ability to blend soulful storytelling with masterful production sets him apart in the ever-evolving Afro-fusion landscape.



With Cold, Bennixx reaffirms his position as an artist. He creates music that not only entertains but also resonates on a deeper level. Stay tuned for more as he continues to make waves in the music industry.



Cold is now available on all major streaming platforms. Listen and experience the magic of Bennixx’s artistry today!

Nigerian rising star UNCLEUGLY is back with a brand-new music pack titled ABUJA, featuring two compelling tracks: ABUJA and OLE. This latest release showcases his dynamic artistry. He blends Afrobeat, Hip-Hop, and contemporary Highlife. The result is a sound that is both conscious and nostalgic.







A Multifaceted Artist with a Unique Vision



Great Oghenetejiri Akpewa, popularly known as UNCLEUGLY, is a force to be reckoned with in Nigeria’s music scene. Born in Surulere, Lagos, and raised in Warri City, he brings a rich cultural heritage into his craft. Since launching his professional career in 2023 in Accra, he has captivated audiences with his rhythmic beats. His vibrant melodies and thought-provoking lyrics also capture attention.




        View this post on Instagram            A post shared by GOD IS GREAT (@uncle.ugly)




UNCLEUGLY’s standout releases, including BRANAMA, KOLO, OGINI, and DUMEBI, have demonstrated his versatility and deep connection to storytelling. With ABUJA and OLE, he continues to push boundaries, crafting a sonic experience that speaks to both ambition and emotion.



The Creative Process Behind ‘ABUJA’



In his own words, UNCLEUGLY describes the significance of his latest tracks: “These songs are two distinctive sounds. ABUJA speaks about my thriving vision to prosper in the music space. It also talks about claiming a spot in the music industry at the capital.”









On the flip side, OLE offers a different vibe, delving into themes of love with a unique twist. “OLE is my soft spot. It’s a romantic song with a toxic reassurance,” he explains. This duality showcases his ability to balance ambition with emotional depth, making his music both relatable and impactful.



Redefining Modern African Sound



Beyond music, UNCLEUGLY wears many creative hats—songwriter, creative director, stylist, and producer. His artistic vision extends beyond just melodies, influencing his entire aesthetic and brand. He draws inspiration from artists like Omah Lay, Mohbad, Lil Kesh, Esskay, and Chronixx. This inspiration helps him carve out a distinct identity within the industry.







With a bold presence and a compelling sound, UNCLEUGLY is not just an artist—he’s a movement. ABUJA is now available on all major streaming platforms. Experience the journey and immerse yourself in the latest chapter of his evolving artistry.

Nigerian Afrobeat and hip-hop sensation ASTROKULTURE returns with his latest release, WOOF. It is a powerful and deeply introspective track. It delves into themes of betrayal, toxicity, and the struggle for freedom from destructive relationships. With its haunting melodies and intense beats, WOOF is set to leave a lasting impact on listeners.







The Artistic Evolution of ASTROKULTURE



Born Mba Wilson on July 17, 2000, in Abuja, ASTROKULTURE has emerged as one of Nigeria’s most promising musical talents. Inspired by artists like Eminem, J. Cole, Kendrick Lamar, Joyner Lucas, and Logic, he began his musical journey at the age of 20. He was guided by his friend Kid Maliq. Producer Freezy Jay also helped in his musical journey.



He initially launched his career under the name Astrowurld. He introduced himself to the industry with his debut EP, Cruise and Sapa. A subsequent rebrand as ASTROKULTURE marked a new phase in his artistic evolution. This led to the release of his first single, Ajaaga, in 2022. It was followed by the drill-inspired No Drama. Both singles gained him industry recognition.







Today, ASTROKULTURE is leading the way in creating his own genre. This genre is called Afro-Emo. It blends the rhythmic elements of Afrobeat with the emotional storytelling of emo rap. His mission is to create music that resonates deeply. He tackles themes of love, pain, and personal growth. He does this while retaining the vibrant essence of African music.



The Creative Process Behind ‘WOOF’



Creating WOOF was an emotional journey for ASTROKULTURE, drawing from personal experiences of betrayal and toxic relationships. “The title WOOF symbolizes an instinctual warning—a call to escape danger,” he explains. The lyrics came naturally, encapsulating internal conflict and heartbreak.









Lines like ‘Pere majon pere, back stab majon pere’ serve as haunting chants of betrayal. The chorus—‘Oh baby please just let me go, ‘cause I’m running from this violence’—is a desperate plea for liberation.



The song’s production mirrors this turmoil, blending melancholic melodies with heavy, intense beats. The mix of English and indigenous expressions adds depth, making it both personal and universally relatable. “Recording WOOF was raw and expressive, with each vocal take emphasizing pain, frustration, and longing,” he reveals. The final production balances dark instrumentals with emotive storytelling, ensuring that the emotions stay the focal point.



Shaping the Future of Afrobeat and Hip-Hop



ASTROKULTURE primarily identifies as an Afrobeat artist. He continues to experiment with trap and hip-hop. He infuses his sound with versatility. His evolving artistry is clear in his growing discography, which includes his second EP, EMOTIONS. As he pushes creative boundaries, ASTROKULTURE remains committed to shaping the future of Afrobeat and hip-hop. This commitment is obvious both in Nigeria and beyond.



With WOOF, ASTROKULTURE delivers a deeply personal yet relatable anthem about love and pain. It also explores the courage to break free from toxicity. The single is now available on all major streaming platforms—immerse yourself in the raw emotion of WOOF today.

Emerging Afrobeat sensation Twyze has officially released his much-anticipated EP, Love Made Me. This project showcases his unique fusion of traditional Nigerian rhythms with contemporary Afrobeat influences. The EP features hit tracks like Somebody, Badder Than, and Faaji-Xpress. It is set to solidify Twyze’s place in the evolving Afrobeat landscape.







A Rising Star with a Distinctive Sound



Twyze (pronounced /twaɪz/) hails from Benue State, Nigeria. He was deeply influenced by the rich cultural heritage of his region. Growing up, he found inspiration in legendary figures like Fela Kuti, King Sunny Ade, and Chief Commander Ebenezer Obey. These foundational influences have shaped his unique sonic identity. He also admires modern Afrobeat icons like Wizkid, Davido, and Burna Boy.




        View this post on Instagram            A post shared by Twyze Bnrd (@twyzegram)




In 2023, Twyze took a bold step in his career by relocating to Lagos, the heart of Nigeria’s music industry. Since then, he has been refining his artistry and collaborating with other talented musicians. His music features infectious rhythms and soulful melodies. The poignant lyrics explore themes of love, social justice, and personal growth.



The Story Behind ‘Love Made Me’



With Love Made Me, Twyze explores the complexities of love and relationships. The stories they narrate resonate with a broad audience. The EP captures the highs and lows of love, from its euphoric moments to its heart-wrenching realities. Each track reflects a different aspect of love’s impact—whether it’s passion, longing, joy, or heartbreak.









Somebody sets the tone with its rhythmic beats and heartfelt lyrics, drawing listeners into Twyze’s world of deep emotions. Badder Than showcases his versatility. He blends sultry melodies with vibrant percussion. Faaji-Xpress delivers an upbeat, celebratory vibe that embodies the essence of Afrobeat.



A Promising Future in Afrobeat



Twyze is not just another artist in the Afrobeat scene. He is a visionary with a mission. He aims to leave a lasting imprint on the genre. His dedication to crafting meaningful and sonically rich music positions him as one of the most exciting newcomers to watch.







With Love Made Me, Twyze proves that love can inspire timeless music. The EP is now available on all major streaming platforms. Dive into Twyze’s world and experience the magic of Love Made Me today!

Zilla Oaks continues to push boundaries in the Nigerian music scene, and his next offering, “Where You Dey”, is set to make waves. Scheduled for release on the 14th, this Spykida-produced track sees Zilla further cementing his reputation as one of Africa’s most dynamic and unpredictable rap talents.







Zilla Oaks: A Force in Nigerian Hip-Hop



Hailing from the Federal Capital of Nigeria, Zilla Oaks has carved out a unique space in the industry with his bold lyricism and genre-blending sound. A founding member of the Apex Village collective, he launched his solo career in 2022, consistently evolving while maintaining his signature intensity.



His last single, “Not One of Them,” was a surprising yet masterful dive into Amapiano, proving his versatility. Now, with “Where You Dey”, he takes another bold step forward, fusing his rap roots with cutting-edge production to create a track that’s both infectious and thought-provoking.



What to Expect from “Where You Dey”



With Spykida behind the boards, “Where You Dey” is expected to carry a sonically rich and immersive sound. Known for crafting beats that balance hard-hitting energy with melodic finesse, Spykida provides the perfect backdrop for Zilla’s effortless delivery.







While details about the song’s theme remain under wraps, the title suggests a track that could explore themes of presence, loyalty, or even a late-night anthem for the city’s restless spirits. One thing is certain—Zilla Oaks never misses when it comes to delivering engaging music.



A New Era for Zilla Oaks?



Zilla has always been about evolution. From raw boom-bap and trap to genre-fusing experimental cuts, he consistently challenges expectations. “Where You Dey” might just be another step in his artistic reinvention, further proving why he remains a standout in contemporary African rap.



As the release date approaches, anticipation is high. Whether you’re a longtime fan or just discovering his sound, this track is one you won’t want to miss.



Mark your calendars—Zilla Oaks is about to set the tone once again!

Abuja’s vibrant alternative music scene is set ablaze as Stoner Nwaigbo, the visionary artist known for his Kakpoo sound, teams up with prolific rapper PsychoYP to deliver the highly anticipated remix of For Abuja. This collaboration seamlessly blends spiritual energy with contemporary hip-hop, cementing both artists as key figures in Nigeria’s evolving alté movement.



Stoner Nwaigbo: The Big Masquerade of Kakpoo Sound



Born Ogwuche Ebuka Odumegwu, Stoner Nwaigbo has steadily carved out a niche with his unique Kakpoo sound—a fusion of spiritual melodies, alternative rhythms, and deep cultural influences. As an Abuja-based artist, he has consistently pushed the boundaries of Nigerian alternative music, using his sound to connect with both ancestral roots and modern sonic landscapes.







Tracks like “Mmiri (Arobinagu) Mamiwater” and “Big Masquerade” have showcased his ability to create music that resonates on a deeply spiritual and emotional level. With For Abuja, Stoner pays homage to the city that has shaped his artistry, capturing its energy, hustle, and eclectic vibe.



PsychoYP: The Fresh Prince of Nigerian Rap Joins Forces



Joining the remix is none other than PsychoYP, one of the most influential voices in Nigeria’s rap scene. Born Nicholas Ihua-Maduenyi, PsychoYP has been instrumental in shaping the Nigerian alternative hip-hop and drill movement. His gritty lyricism, charismatic delivery, and genre-blending style have earned him critical acclaim and a devoted following, both locally and internationally.







PsychoYP’s presence on the remix adds a fresh dimension to For Abuja, delivering high-energy bars that capture the city’s relentless ambition and dynamic culture. His ability to switch between laid-back flows and aggressive punchlines makes the track even more compelling.



‘For Abuja’ Remix: A Celebration of the Capital City



The For Abuja remix isn’t just a song—it’s an anthem that encapsulates the essence of the Nigerian capital. Stoner Nwaigbo’s hypnotic melodies blend effortlessly with PsychoYP’s razor-sharp lyricism, creating a track that is both introspective and energetic.









The song explores themes of city life, resilience, and self-expression, painting a vivid picture of Abuja’s creative landscape. With its infectious production and unique fusion of alté and rap elements, the remix is set to become a staple in the city’s nightlife and beyond.



A Defining Moment for Abuja’s Alternative Scene



This collaboration is more than just a remix—it is a statement. It showcases the synergy between two distinct yet complementary artists and reinforces Abuja’s status as a powerhouse for alternative music in Nigeria.




        View this post on Instagram            A post shared by BIG MASQUERADE  UMU ASA GBA ỌTỌ EFE🪶 (@stoner_nwaigbo)




As Stoner Nwaigbo continues to push the boundaries of Kakpoo sound, and PsychoYP solidifies his place as a leader in Nigerian rap, For Abuja (Remix) stands as a testament to the city’s artistic diversity and boundless creativity.



Listeners can stream the track on all major digital platforms, ensuring that Abuja’s energy and sound reach audiences far beyond its borders.



Final Thoughts



With the release of For Abuja (Remix), Stoner Nwaigbo and PsychoYP have created a sonic experience that is both deeply cultural and refreshingly modern. Their collaboration not only pays tribute to the city they call home but also paves the way for future genre-defying projects in Nigeria’s ever-evolving music landscape.



Whether you’re a fan of alternative music, rap, or just a lover of innovative sounds, this remix is one you don’t want to miss.



Stream For Abuja (Remix) now and immerse yourself in the spirit of the capital!

The Nigerian music industry is set to witness a heartfelt moment as Royal Empire Management (REM) hints at a posthumous release from the late Zumzy Brown. The management took to Twitter today with a simple yet powerful message: “NEW POST HUMOUS. MARCH.” 







This unexpected announcement has left fans eager to hear what’s next from the rapper whose legacy continues to shine even after his passing.



Remembering Zumzy Brown: A Star Gone Too Soon



Zumzy Brown, born Michael Ozumba Uchemba, was a rising rap sensation and a 300-level Political Science student at Veritas University, Abuja. His promising career was tragically cut short on May 4, 2021, following a fatal asthma attack. Despite his untimely departure, Zumzy left behind an impressive catalog of music that resonated deeply with fans.



His Impactful Journey in Music



In 2020, Zumzy Brown released two standout EPs, No Man Doubt and Pastor Baby, which showcased his lyrical dexterity and genre-blending style. Songs like “Problem” featuring Beedee Vocals and “Maxxxxximum” proved his ability to craft compelling narratives backed by infectious beats.







Following his passing, his management released The Legend, Zumzy Brown in 2023—a compilation album that further solidified his influence in Nigerian hip-hop. Tracks like “Die Young” struck an emotional chord with listeners, eerily reflecting on life and legacy.



What to Expect from the March Release?



While details remain scarce, the March release is expected to feature unreleased songs that will offer fans a fresh glimpse into Zumzy’s artistic vision. Given REM’s track record in preserving his legacy, this project is anticipated to be a carefully curated tribute to his immense talent.



The announcement has sparked excitement and nostalgia among fans, who continue to celebrate Zumzy Brown’s contributions to the music scene. His words, “Had too much potential. Good night world,” now hold an even deeper meaning as his music continues to inspire new generations.



A Legacy That Lives On



Zumzy Brown’s influence in Nigerian rap remains undeniable. His raw storytelling, charismatic delivery, and cultural impact ensure that his presence in the industry is far from forgotten. As March approaches, fans are counting down the days until they can once again experience the magic of Zumzy Brown.







Stay tuned for more updates on this posthumous release, and let’s celebrate the enduring legacy of a true lyrical powerhouse.

Nigerian music is a cultural powerhouse, and rising star Kida Oj is making sure the world hears his voice loud and clear. With his latest release, Rara, Kida Oj cements his place as a true innovator in the Afrobeats scene. 







Known for his unmatched diversity and genre-blending style, the Abuja-born singer and songwriter effortlessly fuses Afropop, Afroswing, Dancehall, Trap, Drill, and Alternative sounds with elements of both UK and Nigerian Afrobeats.



Kida Oj: The Rockstar from the Streets



Ayomide Innocent Anota, popularly known as Kida Oj, embodies the perfect blend of raw street energy and rockstar charisma. His music reflects his identity—a mix of ghetto roots and international appeal, balancing local authenticity with a global sound. More than just a musician, Kida Oj is a cultural force, a trendsetter whose appearance and artistic expression are as dynamic as his sound.



‘Rara’ – The Afrobeat Anthem for the World



Rara is not just a song—it’s a statement, a bold showcase of Afrobeats in its purest form. Produced by the renowned Egar Boi, this track carries all the essential elements that make Afrobeats a global phenomenon: melodic vocals, rich African percussions, a catchy hook, and authentic Afro sounds. Kida Oj brings his signature energy to the track, making it a must-listen for fans of both contemporary and classic Afrobeats.









Speaking on his creative process, Kida Oj describes Rara as a real Afrobeat masterpiece that stays true to the genre’s core while also offering something fresh and exciting. With Afrobeats continuing to dominate the global music scene, Rara is a powerful representation of the sound that has put Africa at the center of modern music culture.



A Movement, Not Just a Song



Kida Oj isn’t just dropping music—he’s building a movement. His ability to connect with audiences through powerful storytelling and energetic performances has earned him a loyal fan base. With a strategic promotional push, including playlisting and engagement with his super fans, Rara is set to gain massive exposure and introduce Kida Oj to an even wider audience.







Final Thoughts



If you’re a fan of Afrobeats in its most authentic form, Rara is a track you can’t afford to miss. Kida Oj’s artistic vision, combined with Egar Boi’s masterful production, makes this a potential anthem for 2024 and beyond. Keep an eye on Kida Oj—this Abuja Rockstar is here to stay, and Rara is just the beginning.



Stream Rara now and experience the future of Afrobeats!

Blending Culture, Sound, and Innovation



SeQuence Nyong is a rising Nigerian singer, songwriter, and performer making waves in the music industry. Born and raised in Calabar, Nigeria, and currently navigating his career between Lagos and Calabar, SeQuence has crafted a distinctive sound that sets him apart. Influenced by musical greats such as Burna Boy, Wande Coal, and Jesse Jagz, he brings a refreshing fusion of Afro-Pop and alternative sounds to the forefront of the industry.







A Unique Style Rooted in Afro-Fusion



SeQuence Nyong’s music is a seamless blend of soulful melodies, swinging hooks, and introspective lyrics, enriched with his native Efik dialect. His songs delve into themes of reality, survival, renewable energy, and self-empowerment, all delivered with his versatile vocal range and genre-bending style. As a born performer and entertainer, SeQuence has collaborated with several notable artists and producers, further solidifying his place in the industry.









A Growing Legacy: Discography & Achievements



SeQuence burst onto the scene with his debut single, “Bandwagon,” in 2020, receiving widespread acclaim. His follow-up track, “Se nsi ma,” earned significant airplay across West African radio stations, rapidly growing his audience. In 2023, he released his debut EP, The Epidemic, in Maryland, Lagos, which continues to resonate with his expanding fanbase. Now, he is gearing up for the release of his sophomore EP, Supersonic Vibrations, a project that promises to further showcase his artistry and push creative boundaries.







Stay Tuned for More



With an unwavering passion for music and an ever-evolving sound, SeQuence Nyong is undoubtedly one of the most exciting new artists emerging from Nigeria. As he continues to break barriers and captivate listeners worldwide, there’s no doubt that his journey is just beginning. Stay sharp and keep an eye out for Supersonic Vibrations!

Redefining Hip-Hop, Rap, and Afro-fusion



Richard Ayomide Olamijulo, known professionally as http//:riri, is a dynamic force in the music industry. Originally from Nigeria and now based in Kaunas, Lithuania, he has carved a unique space for himself, seamlessly blending Hip-Hop, Rap, Trap, R&B, Afrobeats, and Afrorap. 







His innovative sound and relentless work ethic have made him one of the most exciting independent artists in the global music scene today.



A DIY Pioneer Making Waves



Http//:riri is more than just an artist; he is a visionary. Writing and producing his own music, he has independently released four albums and numerous singles in under two years—a remarkable feat that highlights his dedication and creativity. His do-it-yourself (DIY) approach extends beyond production, as he actively manages his brand and innovative marketing strategies, ensuring his music reaches audiences far and wide.









From Nigeria to Lithuania: A Global Influence



Despite being an independent artist, Http//:riri has achieved notable streaming milestones, earning recognition both in Nigeria and Lithuania. His music has gained traction on national television in Nigeria and has been featured on prominent radio stations in both countries. This international acclaim speaks volumes about his versatility and the universal appeal of his sound.







Pushing Boundaries and Inspiring Others



Http//:riri is not just making music; he is proving that with passion, resilience, and hard work, anything is possible. His journey serves as an inspiration to aspiring artists worldwide, showing that determination and innovation can break barriers. As he continues to evolve and push creative limits, Http//:riri is undoubtedly an artist to watch on the global stage.

Bridging Music, Film, and Poetry with Innovation



At the forefront of Abuja’s creative evolution stands David Ikani, professionally known as Crosswordz—a multidisciplinary artist, director, and innovator redefining the art of storytelling. Born and raised in Nigeria’s capital with roots in Kogi State, Crosswordz has carved a niche for himself by seamlessly integrating music, film, and poetry to create compelling narratives that captivate audiences.







As the founder of The Greatest Collective and Team Lead for Capitol Film Fest, Abuja’s largest independent film festival, Crosswordz is committed to elevating the city’s creative landscape on a global scale. With extensive experience in stage and screen acting, directing, and visual storytelling, his work reflects a deep passion for pushing artistic boundaries.



A Multi-Award-Winning Visionary



Crosswordz’s impact in the creative space has earned him multiple prestigious awards. His first directed film was selected as the best short film at the African International Film Festival (AFRIFF) 2024, marking a significant milestone in his career. Additionally, he emerged as the grand prize winner of the #TheNaijaWeWant challenge, securing a remarkable one-million-naira prize from Seyi Tinubu. These accolades are a testament to his artistic excellence and commitment to powerful storytelling.



A Leader in Abuja’s Creative Scene



More than an artist, Crosswordz is a catalyst for creative innovation. His ability to craft meaningful narratives extends beyond individual projects, fostering collaborations that amplify the voices of emerging and established creators. His work is instrumental in shaping Abuja’s artistic identity, positioning the city as a growing hub for creative excellence.







Throughout his career, he has collaborated with distinguished creatives, including:




Mad Jamie



Sick Director



Lucas Dusky



Lastson



Jpegsfromdave



Director Sweet



Jojo of Lele




The Future of Crosswordz



With an unwavering commitment to originality and innovation, Crosswordz is continuously exploring new frontiers in storytelling. His work is not just about artistic expression—it is about reshaping narratives and positioning Abuja as a global creative force.




        View this post on Instagram            A post shared by DAVID IKANI (@crosswordz)




As he continues to break new ground, his vision remains clear: to tell impactful stories, build collaborative networks, and establish Abuja as a recognized center for artistic excellence.

Few names in the Nigerian entertainment industry embody vision, innovation, and leadership quite like Cza of REM. Born Tarzaa Gerald Anzenge, he is a formidable presence in the creative space. He wears many hats as a talent manager, strategist, event curator, and cultural architect. Cza founded Royal Empire Management (REM). 







He is the driving force behind it. He has changed how artists and brands navigate the industry. He has left an indelible mark on the ever-evolving Nigerian entertainment landscape.



A Legacy Built on Vision and Execution



Cza’s journey began as a Computer Science graduate of Veritas University. He became a key player in music, events, and creative direction. This journey is a testament to his adaptability and foresight. He saw the untapped potential in Nigeria’s booming music scene. He built REM into a powerhouse. It incubates, develops, and propels artists to greater heights.







His strategic approach to talent management has enabled him to collaborate with various artists. These artists include Odumodublvck, Psycho YP, EESKAY, and Zilla Oaks. Other collaborators are Jess ETA, Humblesmith, Patoranking, Saskay, and Minz. Further artists include OG Mage, Mannie Tseayo, BlaqRose, and ZaddyTC. His ability to find, nurture, and elevate talent has made REM synonymous with success and innovation.



Creative Disruption: RADARCharts & XCAPE



Beyond artist management, Cza is a data-driven creative disruptor. He created RADARCharts, an analytical tool. It measures artist growth and market trends. This innovation has set new standards in how data informs entertainment decisions. By providing insights into an artist’s reach and fan engagement, RADARCharts has empowered industry stakeholders to make smarter business moves.







Additionally, Cza’s event brand, XCAPE, has revolutionized live music experiences. It crafts high-energy tours and exclusive events that attract audiences across the country. XCAPE isn’t just an event series; it’s a movement that brings culture, sound, and unforgettable moments to life.

Renowned Nigerian executive producer and A&R, Kiing Lu, has unveiled the “Militant Recording Camp.” It is a three-day immersive experience. This camp is designed to push the boundaries of African drill music. The camp is scheduled from Thursday, February 6th to Saturday, February 8th, 2025. Its exact location remains private. Attendance is strictly by invitation.







Kiing Lu shared the news on Instagram, reinforcing his vision for the movement:




Date: Thursday 6th – Saturday 8th of February 2025Location: PrivateExecutive producer / A&R: @realkiingluStrictly by invitation.




A Major Push for African Drill



Drill music is known for its dark, bass-heavy production. It features raw, unfiltered lyrics. The genre has seen a global rise. There are strongholds in the UK, US, and parts of Europe. In Africa, the genre is gaining momentum, thanks to artists blending its signature sound with local influences. The “Militant Recording Camp” aims to accelerate this movement. It creates a space where artists can collaborate. They can also innovate and refine their craft.







Kiing Lu’s latest initiative reaffirms his commitment to hip-hop culture in Africa, especially within the drill subgenre. The camp will bring together some of the most talented and promising acts in the scene. It offers them an opportunity to push the boundaries of creativity. This helps further legitimize drill music within African rap.



Kiing Lu: The Visionary Behind the Movement



Born Lucas Emeodi, Kiing Lu has been an influential force in Nigeria’s music industry since 2005. He started as a producer and musician. Over time, he has grown into one of the most respected A&Rs and executive producers. He is known for spotting raw talent and curating impactful projects. His recent project, “Militant Mindset,” exemplifies his dedication to the movement. It features high-profile collaborations with Odumodublvck, Jeriq, Vector, Dremo, and more.







According to Guardian.ng, Kiing Lu has been instrumental in shaping Nigerian hip-hop’s resurgence. This new camp is another step in his journey to cement African drill’s place on the global stage.



What to Expect from “Militant Recording Camp”



Details are scarce. Nonetheless, the exclusive nature of the camp suggests that top-tier artists, producers, and industry figures will join. Attendees can expect intense recording sessions. They will have knowledge-sharing opportunities. Collaborations will birth the next wave of drill anthems from the continent.







As drill music continues to evolve, the “Militant Recording Camp” is ready to make a significant impact on the genre. This will be especially felt in Africa. Kiing Lu is leading the charge. Fans can expect groundbreaking releases. These will further solidify drill’s impact and longevity in the Nigerian and African rap scene.



Stay tuned for more updates as the event unfolds!

In the world of visual storytelling, Chima Victor Agbugba, professionally known as ORACLE, stands out as a photographer. His lens is guided by purpose, passion, and faith. At just 25 years old, the Imo State native has carved a niche for himself in Abuja’s creative scene. He captures stunning images that go beyond aesthetics. These images tell stories, evoke emotions, and preserve moments that last a lifetime.







The Story Behind ORACLE



The name “ORACLE” carries deep significance. His late father (RIP) bestowed it upon him. This title has since shaped his artistic vision. It has also influenced his approach to photography. More than just a name, it signifies his calling to see beyond the ordinary. It encourages him to frame the world through a divine perspective. It also inspires capturing images that speak truth, light, and depth.







A Passion Rooted in Purpose



ORACLE is not just a photographer; he is a visual storyteller with an unwavering love for Jesus. His work reflects intention, creativity, and soul, drawing inspiration from both his faith and the raw, unfiltered beauty of life. Whether it’s portraiture, lifestyle photography, or conceptual shoots, ORACLE has a keen eye for ensuring a message in each frame. The message resonates with both the topic and the viewer. 



Beyond the Lens



ORACLE is based in Abuja. ORACLE is steadily building a reputation for capturing authenticity. They blend light, composition, and emotion to create timeless images. His work is a testament to his dedication to crafting visual narratives that are both striking and meaningful.







As he continues his journey, ORACLE remains committed to using his talent to inspire others. He documents each moment and glorifies the beauty in every experience.



Follow ORACLE’s Creative Journey



Stay connected with ORACLE as he continues to redefine storytelling through photography.



Instagram

Zeph is an Afrobeat sensation. His rise has been nothing short of meteoric. He just dropped a captivating new single titled “For You”. The track features the talented David Acekeyzz. It further solidifies Zeph’s place in the hearts of music lovers worldwide. The song uniquely blends Afro-RnB, Afro-Fusion, and Contemporary Reggae influences.







A Sound That Speaks to the Soul



Born on December 22nd, Zeph has been making waves with his unique fusion of African rhythms and modern R&B influences. He seamlessly combines soul-stirring vocals with captivating instrumentals. This skill has earned him recognition as one of the most promising artists in the Afrobeat landscape.









With For You, Zeph delivers an immersive sonic experience that showcases his incredible vocal range and emotional depth. The track’s rich melodies and smooth harmonies engage listeners powerfully. Its heartfelt lyrics make it a must-listen for lovers of authentic, soul-driven music.



The Creative Process Behind For You



According to Zeph, creating For You was an intensely personal and introspective journey. Speaking on the song’s origins, he shares:




“From the onset, I knew I wanted to craft a song that would resonate with listeners on a fundamental level. To achieve this goal, I engaged in deep self-reflection. I poured my emotions, thoughts, and experiences into the music.”




Collaborating with David Acekeyz played a crucial role in bringing the song to life. The duo started from scratch. They meticulously wove together melodies, harmonies, and rhythms. These elements captured the raw emotions at the heart of the song. Hours of fine-tuning were vital. They recorded soulful vocal takes. Their masterful production made For You emerge as a masterpiece of vulnerability and sonic brilliance.




“The process was challenging. It was also cathartic. Ultimately, it yielded a work of art that I am proud to share with the world. ‘For You’ is more than just a song. It reflects my innermost self. It is a symphony of emotions. It is a testament to the transformative power of music.”




A Musical Fusion of African Sounds and Contemporary Production



The track’s Afrobeat rhythm blends seamlessly with contemporary production, creating a dynamic soundscape that showcases Zeph’s incredible vocal range. His voice, soulful and rich, weaves effortlessly through the carefully crafted instrumentation, delivering a message of love and longing. David Acekeyzz’s input adds strength to the emotional impact. His distinct production style brings depth and warmth to the song.



Zeph: A Rising Star Ready to Take Over the Music World



Zeph’s career is marked by his ability to blend genres effortlessly. He pushes boundaries and creates a sound that feels fresh and exciting. The artist electrifies audiences with his stage presence. His musical versatility is remarkable. He is carving a name for himself in the Afrobeat scene and beyond. As he continues to evolve as an artist, “For You” is just the latest offering. This promises to be a long and successful journey in music.







“For You” is more than just a love song. It’s a reflection of Zeph’s innermost self. This song is a symphony of emotions that invites listeners into his world. Whether you’re a long-time fan or just discovering his music, this single is sure to leave a lasting impression.



Stream “For You“ now and experience the magic of Zeph and David Acekeyzz’s collaboration. It’s a song that speaks to the heart. It reminds us all of the power of love. Music can transform our lives.

In the vibrant world of Afrobeat, Kelly Mayami is a name that’s rapidly gaining recognition. Born Duza Yunusa, the Nigerian artist burst onto the scene in 2022. He brings with him a sound that blends authentic Afrobeat rhythms with deep, socially conscious storytelling.







Growing up in a modest family, Kelly’s journey into music was shaped by passion and perseverance. Before he gained access to professional recording equipment, he honed his skills through songwriting. This helped him develop a style that now sets him apart in the industry.



The Sound of Kelly Mayami



Inspired by the legendary Fela Kuti, Kelly Mayami truly captures the essence of Afrobeat. This genre is more than just music. It serves as a powerful medium for storytelling, activism, and cultural expression.









His breakout track, “Isale Eko”, demonstrated his ability to create music. It not only entertains but also captures the essence of everyday Nigerian life. Through pulsating drum patterns, rich instrumentation, and thought-provoking lyrics, Kelly brings a fresh, yet timeless, energy to Afrobeat.



‘Ekelebe’ – A National Frenzy



Kelly Mayami’s latest release, “Ekelebe”, has set the music scene ablaze, creating a media frenzy across Nigeria. The song’s infectious rhythm stands out. Its engaging storytelling has drawn attention from major media platforms. Music enthusiasts are also captivated.









The success of “Ekelebe” has been amplified by its stunning visuals. These visuals have been featured on RADARCharts and shared by influential platforms such as Tunde Ednut. With such high-profile endorsements, Kelly is solidifying his presence as one of the most exciting new voices in Afrobeat.



A Rising Star with a Purpose



Beyond creating hit songs, Kelly Mayami is an artist with a mission. His music is not just about feel-good vibes—it’s a reflection of life, struggles, and the resilience of the African spirit. Whether he’s speaking on social issues, celebrating culture, or simply making people dance, his work carries an undeniable authenticity.



Afrobeat continues to dominate the global music scene. Kelly Mayami is making sure his voice is heard. He is pushing the genre ahead while staying true to its roots.



What’s Next for Kelly Mayami?



With “Ekelebe” still making waves and his fanbase rapidly growing, Kelly Mayami’s trajectory is nothing short of promising. He is preparing for more releases. He is also planning collaborations and live performances. It’s clear that he is a name to watch in the ever-evolving Afrobeat landscape.







Be part of his journey. Stream “Ekelebe” now. Follow Kelly Mayami on all social media platforms. Stay tuned for more Afrobeat magic!

In the ever-evolving landscape of music, few artists have the versatility and energy that DJ Rahimvibes brings to the stage. Born Yusuf Ibrahim on March 8, 2001, DJ Rahimvibes hails from Niger State, Nigeria. 







He has established himself as a multifaceted talent. DJ Rahimvibes seamlessly blends different musical influences to create a unique and electrifying experience for his audience.



A Fusion of Sounds



DJ Rahimvibes is not confined by genre. His artistry shows a deep understanding of rhythm, melody, and crowd energy. This understanding allows him to effortlessly transition between Afrobeats, Amapiano, Hip-Hop, House, and Highlife. Rahim stands out in high-energy club sets. He also distinguishes himself in festival performances. In intimate gatherings, his ability to read the crowd is exceptional. He curates the perfect vibe.



His genre-defying style has made him a sought-after DJ and artist. He has earned a dedicated fan base that appreciates his experimental yet deeply rooted sound.



Mastering the Art – From Studio to Stage



DJ Rahimvibes is not just a master of the decks; he’s also an innovative studio artist. Over the years, he has refined his skills in music production. He has also honed his abilities in remixing and live performance. These efforts guarantee that his sound remains fresh and relevant. TSK is better known by his stage name Tup Dugg. He is back to shake up the Rap and Grime scene. His new project, Dugg Business, is highly anticipated. The Nigerian-born, India-based artist has carved out a unique lane in music. He blends sharp lyricism, Grime-infused rhythms, and authentic storytelling. His work resonates across borders.







From Confidence Building to Career-Defining



Tup Dugg’s musical journey started as a way to stand out among his peers during his school days. Reflecting on his early years, he shared, “I started making music to be cool in school. I felt I wasn’t funny enough. I also wasn’t fine or fashionable enough.” This quest for self-confidence ignited his passion. His dedication and raw talent have developed it into a career. With Dugg Business, Tup Dugg continues to channel those formative experiences, delivering a project that showcases his growth and versatility.



What to Expect from Dugg Business



Dugg Business isn’t just an album; it’s a statement. The project encapsulates everything Tup Dugg stands for—authenticity, confidence, and boundary-pushing creativity. His single Off Am was a success. It introduced listeners to his unapologetic style. This project dives even deeper into the persona of Tup Dugg.









Featuring hard-hitting beats and thought-provoking lyrics, Dugg Business offers a unique fusion of Rap and Grime. It explores themes of resilience, self-belief, and ambition. Each track reflects Tup Dugg’s mantra. He says, “Whenever I’m creating, I always tell myself I am the best.” Then he does his best.



A Global Voice for a New Era of Rap



Tup Dugg stands out because he blends his Nigerian roots with the global sounds of Grime and Rap. Now based in India, Tup Dugg brings a cross-cultural perspective to his music. He creates a sound that feels fresh and uniquely his own. With Dugg Business, he’s not just making music—he’s building a legacy.




        View this post on Instagram            A post shared by T.S.K (@tup_duggg)




Why Dugg Business Deserves a Spot on Your Playlist



If you’re a fan of dynamic lyricism and innovative soundscapes, Dugg Business is a must-listen. From club bangers to introspective tracks, the project offers something for every mood, showcasing Tup Dugg’s versatility and creative range.



Dive into Dugg Business today and experience the bold evolution of Rap and Grime through the eyes of Tup Dugg. This is his moment—and he’s making it count.

Nigerian music’s next big thing, GEEZYSHORE, is set to drop his latest project, EASYMUZZ. It promises to be a statement-making masterpiece. This two-track release—featuring the songs “EASY” and “MUZZ”—solidifies his position as one of Abuja’s most versatile and innovative artists.







The Making of EASYMUZZAccording to GEEZYSHORE, the project is more than just music; it’s a rallying call for recognition. “We all know if they’re to call any big artiste in Abuja, obviously, it has to be ODUMODUBLVCK. But what about us? What about our OGs? Why aren’t they seen that way yet?” These questions served as the creative fuel for EASYMUZZ, inspired by industry titans like REMA and ODUMODUBLVCK.




        View this post on Instagram            A post shared by EASYMUZZ ☝️😎 (@geezyshoree)




GEEZYSHORE describes the project as a personal challenge and a challenge to the industry. He aims to prove that he and others like him deserve to be seen and heard. They should be celebrated as major players in the music world. With EASYMUZZ, he seeks to amplify the voices of Abuja’s underrepresented talents and bring their artistry to the global stage.



A Rising Star with an Unmistakable SoundJoel “GEEZYSHORE” Isaac is quickly becoming a household name in Nigeria’s music scene. He is known for his unique blend of Drill, Melodic Rap, and Afro-Swing. His genre-defying artistry has earned him the title of “Drill Rap Chief.” His music draws comparisons to heavyweights like ODUMODUBLVCK, Black Sherif, and Prettyboy D-O. However, GEEZYSHORE’s soulful storytelling sets him apart. His introspective lyrics and dynamic melodies also make him a standout in his own right.



GEEZYSHORE was born and is based in Abuja. He uses his surroundings and personal experiences. His rapidly growing fanbase is the Geezus Geng. Their support helps him craft songs that resonate on a deeply emotional level. His music is a celebration of excellence, quality, and passion—attributes that shine through in every note of EASYMUZZ.







Why EASYMUZZ MattersIn a music industry dominated by Lagos-based artists, GEEZYSHORE sends a message. They are making it clear that Abuja is a force to be reckoned with. EASYMUZZ is not just a project; it’s a bold declaration that Abuja’s music scene deserves its moment in the spotlight.



If you’re ready to experience cutting-edge Drill, Afro-Swing, and Melodic Rap with a message, get excited. GEEZYSHORE’s EASYMUZZ is the release you’ve been waiting for.



Final ThoughtsGEEZYSHORE is redefining the music landscape with determination. He is proving that big names aren’t confined to specific cities. EASYMUZZ is more than just a project; it’s a movement, a challenge, and a promise of greatness. As GEEZYSHORE continues to rise, his rhythm will leave an indelible mark on the industry. His lyrical prowess and creativity are also undeniable.



Stay tuned for EASYMUZZ—this is a release you won’t want to miss.

Rising star Forbin Audrey has officially unveiled her deeply personal project. Kieleh is now available on Colorfol music app. Audrey is known for her soulful artistry. Her storytelling is evocative. Audrey’s latest release is a transformative journey. It explores themes of healing, growth, and self-discovery.







About Kieleh



Kieleh is more than just an album—it’s a heartfelt expression of resilience and hope. The seven-track project showcases Forbin Audrey’s lyrical brilliance and the collaborative artistry of talented musicians. 







Audrey describes the creation process as “therapeutic and healing,” a journey that allowed her to channel her emotions into music. The project’s title track, Kieleh, anchors the album with its emotional depth. Songs like Believers Incantation and Intentional highlight her ability to blend rich melodies with profound lyrics.



A Musical Journey to Remember



Kieleh takes listeners on a soulful and introspective journey, weaving powerful storytelling with lush, emotive sounds. Tracks like Summayaah and A Child is Born further showcase Audrey’s ability to connect deeply with her audience. This connection makes this project an unforgettable experience.




        View this post on Instagram            A post shared by F🪐RBIN (@forbin_audrey)




Why Kieleh Deserves Your Attention



Forbin Audrey’s authenticity shines through every lyric and note, setting her apart as a true artist. Kieleh resonates with themes of personal growth and healing, making it a project that speaks to the soul. Whether you’re seeking inspiration or simply craving beautifully crafted music, Kieleh delivers on all fronts.



Stream Kieleh Today

Innovative Afro-fusion artist Yng Ryme is starting the year with a bang. He releases his first single of 2025, Swirl. The Owerri-born artist is known for his dynamic blend of Afro Beats and Afro Alte. He brings a fresh sound. This sets the tone for an exciting year ahead.







A Fresh ChapterSwirl is more than just a song; it’s a celebration of rhythm and vibe. Yng Ryme uses smooth melodies and infectious beats. He also incorporates relatable themes. This approach creates a track that resonates deeply with fans and showcases his versatility. This new single marks a fresh chapter in his musical journey. He continues to push the boundaries of his artistry.









From Owerri to Afro Beats StardomChidera Chimamkpa Smart is known professionally as Yng Ryme. He has been steadily building his reputation since his debut EP, Climax, in 2022. His breakout single, Want It, showed his ability to craft memorable tunes. His 2024 project, Joromi, highlighted his authenticity to his roots. Now, with Swirl, Yng Ryme reaffirms his place as a rising star in the Afro Beats scene.



Why ‘Swirl’ Stands OutThis track is a masterful blend of high-energy Afro Beats and introspective Afro Alte elements. The vibrant production, paired with Yng Ryme’s signature lyricism, creates a song that’s both catchy and meaningful. Whether it’s the pulsing rhythm or the soulful undertones, Swirl is bound to leave a lasting impression on listeners.




        View this post on Instagram            A post shared by Yng Ryme (@yngrymee)




A Promising Year AheadYng Ryme kicks off the year with Swirl. Fans can expect even more exciting projects. There will also be exciting collaborations. He anticipates working alongside Snow Fella on Mendez & Boss. This collaboration promises to make the year a milestone for this talented artist.







Stream Swirl Now

Mark your calendars! Nigerian Afrobeat sensation FLUID is set to release his highly-anticipated project, Love, Money, and Good Vibes, on January 31st, 2025. This seven-track masterpiece promises a journey through love, ambition, and the pursuit of happiness, blending Afrobeat, hip-hop, and R&B in FLUID’s signature style.



Tracklist



About FLUID



Born and raised in Lagos, Nigeria, FLUID is a boundary-pushing artist known for his innovative storytelling and genre-bending soundscapes. His debut project, FLUIDIZED EP, featured standout tracks like “KOLD,” “ABENA,” and “FALALA,” earning him critical acclaim and a loyal fanbase.



FLUID’s music reflects life’s complexities, blending silky vocals, introspective lyrics, and captivating rhythms to resonate with listeners worldwide. Beyond his music, FLUID’s creative ventures into fashion and visual arts showcase his forward-thinking approach to artistry.



The Inspiration Behind Love, Money, and Good Vibes



FLUID shares his vision for the project: “To be whole, healthy, and happy, you need love, money, and a lot of good vibes. While creating this project, my aim was to give a complete and holistic feel of a good life to every listener.”



Official Artwork



The project is a testament to FLUID’s ability to craft music that uplifts and inspires, featuring tracks like the soulful “Wande,” the motivational “Paper,” and the celebratory “Juice.” With each song offering its unique vibe, Love, Money, and Good Vibes is a soundtrack for living life to the fullest.



Presave Now!



Be among the first to experience Love, Money, and Good Vibes. Presave the project now and get ready for an unforgettable musical journey on January 31st.



Presave link

Oshodi, Lagos, is no stranger to hustle, energy, and raw ambition. Fozter embodies these traits like few others. He is a dynamic rapper whose journey epitomizes perseverance and passion. With his bold declaration, “I’m a little rapper with big dreams. I will take the world someday,” Fozter is carving a path as one of Nigeria’s most exciting Hip-Hop talents.



Fozter



Humble Beginnings, Big Dreams



Born and raised in Imo State, Fozter started professionally making music in 2018. Yet, his talent truly began to gain traction in 2020. Viral online freestyles captured the attention of both Nigerian and international heavyweights in the music industry. A dream quickly became a formidable career. Fozter stands out as one of the most resilient and skilled rappers in the country.



A Trailblazer in Rap Challenges



Fozter’s rise to prominence has been fueled by his remarkable success in rap competitions. He has faced thousands of competitors. He consistently emerges as a finalist. He leaves an unforgettable impression with his razor-sharp lyricism and energetic performances.










2020 Monster Challenge: Among 3,000 rappers, Fozter made it to the finalists, proving his exceptional talent.



TomTom Challenges (2021 & 2022): Secured third place in two consecutive years, showcasing his consistency and growth.



Go Nigeria Rap Challenge: Achieved third place once again, solidifying his position as a force to be reckoned with.



2022 Hennessy VS Class: Outperformed 6,000 other rappers. Delivered what many consider the most electrifying battle in the competition’s history.



Boomplay Pass The Mic: Dominated and clinched first place against 1,000 rappers, establishing his reign as a top-tier lyricist.




Collaborations with Legends



Fozter’s journey has also been marked by landmark collaborations that show his growing influence. He landed a verse from U.S. rap legend Tech N9ne and appeared on a cypher with African Hip-Hop icon The Guy (formerly M.I Abaga). These achievements underscore his undeniable talent and his ability to compete on both local and global stages.









A Promising Future



Fozter’s combination of lyrical prowess, unrelenting energy, and dedication to his craft has earned him a notable reputation. He is considered the most prolific up-and-coming rapper in the Nigerian music scene. As he continues to rise, it’s clear that Fozter is not just a name to watch. He symbolizes what’s possible with hard work and raw talent.









Fozter has a growing list of accolades and a passionate fanbase. His sights are set on global domination. He is on the brink of taking the world by storm. For Hip-Hop enthusiasts, his journey is one to follow closely—because this “little rapper with big dreams” is destined for greatness.

In the heart of Lagos, Nigeria, a new wave of alternative music is emerging. Vwore—formerly known as Propaganda Grey—is at the forefront of this movement. This talented artist is based in Lekki. Yet, they hail from Delta State. They have built a reputation for being one of Nigeria’s most promising MCs. They are also recognized as creative minds.



Propaganda Grey



From Propaganda Grey to Vwore



The rebrand from Propaganda Grey to Vwore marks a significant chapter in his artistic journey. Embracing his Delta heritage, “Vwore” (pronounced WAR-EH) is derived from his native name, Oghenevwore. This transition reflects his shift toward a more personal artistic identity. It allows him to connect even deeper with his audience.









The Early Days



Vwore’s story began at the age of 12 when he started rapping, inspired by the limitless possibilities of hip-hop. His natural talent quickly propelled him to the forefront. This led to his impressive performance as a contestant in the prestigious Hennessy VS Class. Vwore was selected as one of 32 rappers from over a thousand applicants. He proved why he’s considered one of the top emerging voices in Nigerian rap.



Making His Mark with “Beta”



In the underground scene, Vwore made waves with his Afro-rap record, “Beta,” produced by his best friend and collaborator, Sleke. The track’s blend of introspective lyricism captured the attention of alternative music enthusiasts. Its hard-hitting beats also helped solidify his place as a rising star in the Nigerian music landscape.









A Year of Ambition



With his underground traction steadily growing, Vwore has set his sights on taking over the industry. “This year, I’m coming for the crown,” he boldly declares. This signals his determination to ascend to the pinnacle of Nigerian music. He merges alternative sounds with raw, poetic storytelling. This positions him as a standout artist. He is capable of reshaping the narrative around Nigerian hip-hop and rap.



What’s Next for Vwore?



As he navigates this new chapter under the name Vwore, fans can expect music that reflects his personal experiences. It will explore his cultural roots and showcase his bold aspirations. His journey from being a skilled rapper to a full-fledged alternative artist is a testament to his growth and versatility.







You don’t want to miss Vwore. It doesn’t matter if you’ve been tracking him since his Propaganda Grey days or are just discovering his music. Lagos is buzzing with new talent. Vwore is undoubtedly one of the most exciting voices shaping the future of alternative music in Nigeria.

Lagos, Nigeria, is known as the beating heart of Afrobeat. It is home to some of the most dynamic talents on the continent. Among its rising stars stands Enzzy Boi. He is a versatile artist with a knack for blending genres and touching hearts. Enzzy Boi’s music transcends boundaries, from Afrobeat to R&B, reggae, hip-hop, and beyond. He creates a soundscape as diverse as the global audience he is destined to captivate.



Enzzy Boi



A Rising Star with a Modern Afrobeat Twist



Enzzy Boi isn’t just another Afrobeat artist; he’s a force of nature. His ability to fuse traditional African rhythms with modern influences has set him apart as a trailblazer in the genre. Enzzy Boi’s live performances are electrifying. His heartfelt studio recordings also captivate audiences. His magnetic presence leaves an impression that lingers long after the music stops.









Music Rooted in Struggles and Resilience



At the core of Enzzy Boi’s artistry is a commitment to telling real, relatable stories. His breakout track, “Far Away,” stands as a testament to his depth as a songwriter and storyteller. A haunting yet empowering Afrobeat anthem, “Far Away” explores complex emotions. It delves into the nuances of depression, weaving a poignant narrative of struggle and resilience. The track’s evocative lyrics and lingering melody offer listeners a sense of hope. It shows that even in the darkest moments, strength and light can prevail.









Versatility as a Strength



One of Enzzy Boi’s defining features is his unmatched versatility. He refuses to be confined to one genre. He seamlessly moves between Afrobeat, reggae, pop, R&B, and hip-hop. He creates music that appeals to a wide range of listeners. This ability to adapt and experiment with different sounds ensures that there’s something for everyone in his discography.



A Star in the Making



Enzzy Boi is a fast-rising artist in the bustling Lagos music scene. He is poised to make waves far beyond his home city. He is dedicated to authenticity. He channels personal struggles into universal messages. His boundless creativity makes him a standout talent in the industry.







With his infectious energy, genre-bending sound, and powerful storytelling, Enzzy Boi is not just making music—he’s creating a movement. Keep an eye on this Afrobeat sensation. He continues to redefine the genre. He is leaving an indelible mark on the global music stage.

Aj Daviis, the rising Afrobeats sensation from Abuja, Nigeria, continues to blaze his trail in the music industry with relentless energy and a distinctive sound that reflects both his roots and his ambitions. This week, he reached a new milestone, earning the title of RADARCharts Star of the Week—a well-deserved recognition for an artist whose journey has been marked by passion, resilience, and an unyielding commitment to his craft.







The accolade follows his standout performance and representation at the recently concluded On The Radar Concert, where Aj Daviis proved why he is one of the most exciting voices emerging from Abuja’s vibrant music scene. His set at the concert was a perfect showcase of his ability to connect with his audience, blending infectious Afrobeats rhythms with a modern, genre-defying edge that left fans and industry insiders alike buzzing with admiration.









Aj Daviis’s rise to prominence has not come without challenges. As a symbol of endurance in Abuja’s music scene, he has worked tirelessly to carve a niche for himself in a competitive industry. His music reflects this journey, blending soulful melodies with dynamic storytelling that resonates with listeners on a deep emotional level. From Abuja’s bustling streets to the global stage, Aj Daviis carries the essence of his city’s culture while representing a new generation of artists redefining what it means to be a Nigerian musician.




        View this post on Instagram            A post shared by AJ DAVIIS (@realdaviis)




The recognition from RADARCharts is not only a testament to Aj Daviis’s growing influence but also to his ability to bring people together through music. His tracks, infused with energy, emotion, and a unique blend of traditional Afrobeats and contemporary sounds, continue to draw widespread acclaim. The artist’s authentic representation of the Abuja music scene and his growing connection with fans have positioned him as one to watch in the ever-evolving global music landscape.



As Aj Daviis continues his ascent, this new achievement marks just the beginning of what promises to be an extraordinary career. With his unrelenting drive, raw talent, and the ability to inspire through his art, he is not only a rising star but a beacon of hope for other aspiring artists in Abuja and beyond.







The world is now paying attention, and with Aj Daviis shining brightly as this week’s RADARCharts Star, it’s clear that his sound is here to stay—an anthem for resilience, culture, and the unbreakable spirit of a true artist.

The Nigerian music industry continues to produce trailblazing talents, and one name that is quickly gaining recognition is Nduka Junior Chinwo, popularly known as BLJAY. Born on October 12, 2000, in the vibrant city of Port Harcourt, Rivers State, BLJAY is an emerging force in the Afrobeats movement. With a unique blend of Afrobeats, Afro-pop, and Afro-fusion, his music resonates deeply, reflecting his environment and personal experiences.







Humble Beginnings and Artistic Journey



BLJAY’s journey into music is one of passion and purpose. Though he began his career at the age of 23, his connection to music was cultivated long before. Growing up in the cultural hub of Port Harcourt, BLJAY was inspired by the rhythm of his surroundings. His music channels the energy, struggles, and hope of his community, creating a sound that feels authentic and relatable.



Launching his career in 2023, BLJAY has quickly gained attention for his fresh perspective and genre-bending artistry. His music goes beyond catchy beats, delivering heartfelt lyrics and melodies that resonate across diverse audiences.



A Unique Sound in Afrobeats



BLJAY’s artistry lies in his ability to blend genres seamlessly, drawing influences from Afrobeats, Afro-pop, and Afro-fusion to create a sound that is unmistakably his own. His music is characterized by infectious rhythms, soulful vocals, and compelling storytelling, setting him apart in a competitive industry.

Lagos and Ibadan are two cities pulsing with cultural energy. They have birthed countless musical icons. Jxck Frost is set to join their ranks. Jxck Frost is a lyrical powerhouse. He blends the essence of hip-hop with Afrocentric vibes. He redefines African rap with a refreshing mix of storytelling, multi-syllabic rhymes, and unforgettable hooks.



Jxck Frost



A Fusion of Inspiration and Originality



Jxck Frost draws inspiration from some of the greatest names in rap: J.Cole’s introspective storytelling, Eminem’s technical prowess, MI Abaga’s ingenuity, and Olamide’s authentic Nigerian flavor. Jxck Frost combines these influences with his own unique style. He creates music that bridges cultures. His music resonates with audiences across the globe.









His signature sound is a seamless fusion of raw energy and infectious hooks. These elements are wrapped in clever wordplay and intricate rhyme schemes. With every verse, Jxck Frost invites listeners to explore themes of ambition and resilience. He shares the realities of life through the lens of his African roots.



Championing African Rap on a Global Stage



Jxck Frost is more than just a rapper—he’s on a mission to elevate African hip-hop to new heights. By infusing traditional Nigerian influences into contemporary rap, he’s creating a sound that feels both global and distinctly African. His work speaks to a new generation of listeners who crave authenticity and innovation in equal measure.









Why Jxck Frost is a Name to Watch



Jxck Frost’s music is not just about clever rhymes; it’s a masterclass in artistry. He has the ability to weave intricate stories. He delivers hard-hitting bars. This ensures his songs stay with you long after the beat fades. Jxck Frost performs in the bustling streets of Lagos. He also captivates the vibrant music scenes of Ibadan. His undeniable charisma and raw talent command attention.



The Future of Jxck Frost



Jxck Frost combines Afro-infused hip-hop, technical skill, and an unwavering commitment to his craft. He is on track to become a major force in the music industry. As he continues to push boundaries, one thing is clear. Jxck Frost is not just making music. He’s creating a legacy.







Keep an eye on this rising star. He is taking African hip-hop to the world stage, one bar at a time.

TSK is better known as Tup Dugg. He is redefining the Rap and Grime scene with his latest single, Off Am. The Nigerian-born artist is now based in India. He has consistently proven himself as a force to be reckoned with. He blends sharp lyricism with a signature Grime sound that sets him apart from his peers.







From Humble Beginnings to Grime Greatness



Tup Dugg’s journey into music began during his school days. “I started making music to be cool in school. I felt I wasn’t funny, fine, or fashionable enough,” he says. What started as a way to boost his confidence turned into a lifelong passion for Rap music. Over the years, Tup Dugg honed his craft. He channeled his insecurities into powerful verses. He made a name for himself as an artist unafraid to push boundaries.



Enter Off Am



Tup Dugg’s new single, Off Am, is more than just a song—it’s an anthem. This track introduces listeners to the unapologetic, confident character of Tup Dugg. It showcases his lyrical creativity. His unique Grime-infused Rap style is highlighted. Off Am features a mix of hard-hitting beats. It also includes thought-provoking lyrics. This showcases Tup Dugg’s ability to captivate listeners. He keeps them coming back for more.









In the artist’s own words, “Whenever I’m creating, I always tell myself I am the best.” Then, I do my best. This mindset is clear in Off Am, which exudes confidence, energy, and artistic brilliance.



Why Off Am is a Must-Listen



Whether you’re a longtime fan of Grime or new to the genre, Off Am is a track that demands attention. Tup Dugg’s unique approach to storytelling and sound design creates a listening experience that’s both refreshing and electrifying. The song boldly declares self-belief and resilience. These themes resonate universally and make it a standout release in today’s Rap scene.



Connect with Tup Dugg



Tup Dugg continues to push the boundaries of Rap music. Fans can expect even more groundbreaking releases soon. Stay connected with him on all social media platforms to be the first to hear about his upcoming projects.







With Off Am, Tup Dugg cements his place as a rising star in the global Rap and Grime scene. Don’t just listen—experience the evolution of Rap music through the lens of Tup Dugg.

Lagos is the vibrant heartbeat of Nigeria’s music scene. It continues to unearth extraordinary talent. Astrumm is quickly becoming a name to remember. Formerly known as Storm, this versatile artist seamlessly blends Hip-Hop, Afrobeats, and R&B. The result is a sound that is both contemporary and timeless.



Astrumm



From Eastern Roots to Lagos Spotlight



Astrumm hails from Eastern Nigeria and is now based in Lagos. Her journey into music is deeply rooted in her love for storytelling. Astrumm is renowned for her exceptional pen game. She combines intricate lyricism with mesmerizing flows. Her songs resonate with authenticity and passion.







Her influences read like a hall of fame for global music icons. They include Snoop Dogg, Eminem, Tupac, Michael Jackson, Kendrick Lamar, Nicki Minaj, Fela Kuti, Lupe Fiasco, and Rihanna. This diverse range of inspirations has shaped Astrumm’s sound into a genre-defying blend that connects with fans across cultures.



Moments That Defined Her Career



Astrumm’s artistry first caught major attention with a standout performance on Amazing Klef’s SHOWOFF, Nigeria’s premier freestyle platform. Her razor-sharp lyricism and commanding stage presence set her apart as a force to be reckoned with.



Astrumm built on this momentum. She leveraged social media to showcase her talent. This effort gained her recognition from prominent artists like Qing Madi, Dandizzy, and Ayra Starr. Her widely acclaimed cover of Spyro’s “Shutdown” further solidified her place in the spotlight. Both fans and critics praised her international-grade sound.




        View this post on Instagram            A post shared by Tthe Prophecy (@the_astrumm)




A Balance of Talent and Ambition



Astrumm is not just a rising star in music. She’s also an undergraduate biochemist. She balances her academic pursuits with her artistic ambitions. This dual dedication reflects her resilience and determination, traits that shine through in her honest, heartfelt lyrics.



Why Astrumm Is One to Watch



With her powerful vocals, dynamic artistry, and an ever-growing fan base, Astrumm is carving her path to stardom. Her ability to infuse her music with raw emotion and intricate storytelling sets her apart in a competitive industry.



As she continues to evolve, Astrumm is poised to leave an indelible mark on Nigeria’s music scene and beyond. Keep an eye on this exceptional talent—her star is only just beginning to rise.

Gospel Onyekachi Azubuike is widely recognized as Star Fish. He is set to unveil his highly anticipated project, Star Fish Of My Own Time. This transformative body of work explores the themes of resilience. It delves into personal struggles and unwavering faith. All are delivered through Star Fish’s signature Afrobeat-infused sound. He aptly describes it as “Sound from the Mud.”







About Star Fish



Star Fish hails from Port Harcourt, Rivers State. He is a rising singer-songwriter. His musical journey has been defined by passion. He has shown relentless hard work. He started by performing as a young rapper at local events. Over time, he evolved into a versatile Afrobeat artist. His career trajectory has been nothing short of inspiring.



Star Fish holds a bachelor’s degree in Geology from the prestigious Rivers State University. This achievement demonstrates his ability to balance academic excellence with artistic pursuits. His breakthrough single, Faith, introduced listeners to his unique storytelling ability and paved the way for a clearer artistic vision. Through his music, Star Fish brings to life the everyday realities of his journey. He offers an authentic connection with his fans.



The Project: Star Fish Of My Own Time



Star Fish Of My Own Time is a testament to the artist’s growth and determination. Featuring two powerful tracks, the project showcases Star Fish’s ability to craft relatable narratives while exploring fresh sounds.







Creative Vision and Process



According to Star Fish, this project was born out of relentless effort and an unwavering commitment to his craft. “This work was recorded night and day,” he explains. He emphasizes the passion and dedication poured into every aspect of the project. With Star Fish Of My Own Time, he invites listeners into his world. He shares stories of triumph, struggle, and hope. He does this through his carefully crafted lyrics and compelling soundscapes.







Why This Release Matters



This project is not just another addition to Star Fish’s discography; it is a defining moment in his career. It shows his evolution as an artist. It highlights his connection to his roots. He speaks to universal struggles through a distinctly personal lens. The project incorporates collaborations with some of the industry’s most promising talents. It expands Star Fish’s artistic boundaries. The result is a work that is as diverse as it is cohesive.



Release Day Details



The much-anticipated Star Fish Of My Own Time drops on January 27th, 2025. Fans and music enthusiasts are encouraged to pre-save the project now. This ensures they are among the first to experience this deeply personal and expertly crafted work.



Click here to Pre-Save



Looking Ahead



As Star Fish prepares to release this monumental project, he takes significant steps. He continues to solidify his place as one of Nigeria’s most promising Afrobeat artists. His unique sound, authenticity, and relentless drive are clear. Star Fish Of My Own Time is positioned to resonate with his loyal fanbase. It will also connect with a global audience.



Stay tuned. Star Fish continues to redefine what it means to create music. His work is both deeply personal and universally impactful. On January 27th, join him on this journey and experience the Sound from the Mud like never before.

Ozumba Michael Law, better known as Zumzy Brown, was a shining star in Abuja’s vibrant music scene. Zumzy was known for his lyrical genius. His versatile sound made significant contributions to Hip Hop and Afrobeat. These contributions left an indelible mark on Nigeria’s music landscape. Unfortunately, his life was tragically cut short in 2021.







A Rising Star



Zumzy Brown, a 300-level Political Science student at Veritas University, Abuja, seamlessly balanced academics with his growing music career. Cza managed him under Royal Empire Management (REM). He was more than an artist. He was a storyteller, a lyricist, and a voice for his generation. His songs included hits like Maxxxxximum, School Waka, and Pull Up. They showcased his ability to blend traditional Hip Hop vibes with Afrobeat energy. This created a sound that resonated with fans across Nigeria and beyond.









Tragic Loss



On May 4th, 2021, Zumzy Brown passed away after suffering an asthmatic attack in Wuse, Abuja. His untimely death sent shockwaves through the music industry and among his fans. Just before his passing, Zumzy left a haunting message on social media: “Had too much potential. Good night world.” This poignant note now serves as a reminder. It highlights the talent that the Nigerian music scene lost far too soon.







Keeping the Legacy Alive



Despite his tragic passing, Zumzy’s music continues to thrive. Under the stewardship of Royal Empire Management, his team has worked tirelessly to honor his legacy. On November 23, 2024, his posthumous track Long Talk was released as part of his upcoming project Long Live Zumzy. The compilation album The Legend, Zumzy Brown shows his artistry. Law the Cypher is a joint management project named in his memory. It celebrates his influence on Hip Hop culture.









Zumzy’s Enduring Impact

Ozumba Michael Law, better known as Zumzy Brown, was a shining star in Abuja’s vibrant music scene. Zumzy was known for his lyrical genius. His versatile sound made significant contributions to Hip Hop and Afrobeat. These contributions left an indelible mark on Nigeria’s music landscape. Unfortunately, his life was tragically cut short in 2021.

A Rising Star

Zumzy Brown, a 300-level Political Science student at Veritas University, Abuja, seamlessly balanced academics with his growing music career. Cza managed him under Royal Empire Management (REM). He was more than an artist. He was a storyteller, a lyricist, and a voice for his generation. His songs included hits like Maxxxxximum, School Waka, and Pull Up. They showcased his ability to blend traditional Hip Hop vibes with Afrobeat energy. This created a sound that resonated with fans across Nigeria and beyond.

Tragic Loss

On May 4th, 2021, Zumzy Brown passed away after suffering an asthmatic attack in Wuse, Abuja. His untimely death sent shockwaves through the music industry and among his fans. Just before his passing, Zumzy left a haunting message on social media: “Had too much potential. Good night world.” This poignant note now serves as a reminder. It highlights the talent that the Nigerian music scene lost far too soon.

Keeping the Legacy Alive

Despite his tragic passing, Zumzy’s music continues to thrive. Under the stewardship of Royal Empire Management, his team has worked tirelessly to honor his legacy. On November 23, 2024, his posthumous track Long Talk was released as part of his upcoming project Long Live Zumzy. The compilation album The Legend, Zumzy Brown shows his artistry.
